titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal principal/chercheur principal I/II

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Senior Principal Scientist/Principal Scientist I/II, Oncology (RLT)
#LI-Onsite
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Shape the future of cancer treatment by driving innovative radioligand therapies from discovery to clinic. As a scientific leader within our Oncology Drug Discovery team in Basel, you will lead cutting-edge preclinical research, designing impactful in vivo studies and collaborating across global, multidisciplinary teams to unlock the potential of next-generation cancer treatments. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine scientific excellence with leadership—mentoring talent, influencing strategy, and translating complex data into meaningful insights that accelerate life-changing therapies for patients worldwide.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Design and lead in vivo studies supporting preclinical evaluation of radioligand therapies

• Drive efficacy, biodistribution, imaging, and mechanism of action studies across oncology programs

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance drug candidates toward clinical development

• Manage external partnerships with contract research organizations and academic collaborators

• Mentor, guide, and develop scientists to strengthen scientific and professional capabilities

• Present data and insights clearly to influence decisions across global research and development teams

Essential Requirements

• Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmacology, Cell Biology, or a related biomedical discipline

• Minimum three years of additional experience in biomedical research within academia or industry

• Strong background in cancer biology with a proven track record of scientific achievement

• Extensive experience designing and managing in vivo oncology studies, including efficacy and pharmacokinetic assessment

• Expertise in ex vivo analysis methods such as flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry, or RNA sequencing

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and global research teams

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, both written and verbal

• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to independently drive scientific projects forward

Desirable Requirements

• Experience in radioligand therapy development or radiobiology

• Strong understanding of drug development within oncology or related therapeutic areas

This is a dual level posting. The final level and title for this position will be determined following the completion of the candidate evaluation process, based on skills, experience, and organizational needs

Switzerland Accessibility and accommodation Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

titleByLocale.fr: Associate Directeur, Therapeutic Area Communications

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00

Job Description Summary
Location: East Hanover NJ, US or Basel Switzerland. This role will follow a hybrid working model. If based in US, please apply to REQ-10080236 LI-#hybrid

The Associate Director, Therapeutic Area (TA) Communications supports the development and execution of high impact product/portfolio communications strategies for the TA across Global and the United States.

Please note there are four Associate Dir, TA Comms positions to fill.

Job Description
Job Responsibilities

• Support development and execution of integrated communications strategy based on deep understanding of market dynamics, communications trends, and audience insights​

• Serve as an integral and well-informed partner to cross-functional development and commercial teams to identify when and where Communications can drive the greatest impact in support of Brand & Therapeutic Area strategy​

• Engage & integrate functional expertise including media relations, digital marketing, internal & executive communications, patient & issues advocacy, and market & audience analytics to support key Brand and Therapeutic Area communications milestones and activities​

• Lead brand and disease state narrative and storytelling efforts including optimizing AEO in today’s evolving communications landscape

• Manage risk to Novartis and Brand reputation

• Develop ongoing reporting evaluating the impact of communications strategy aligned to business objectives

• Deliver executional excellence, while being fully consistent with the evolving legal, regulatory and compliance environment​

• Efficient management of comms budget

Key Performance Indicators

• Impact of communications insights and strategies on brand and organizational goals; recognition of their quality

• Functional alignment of communications strategies, priorities and objectives across therapeutic area

• Narrative uptake across key audiences including AI search

• Utilization of OGSM framework planning approach with measurable results and assessment

• Success rate in issue management in areas/geographies critical to the business

• Feedback from internal and external stakeholders on collaboration, thought leadership, expertise

• Ownership of development plan

Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree required

• 7+ years of experience in communications with significant prior experience in brand communications disciplines, including data and regulatory milestones

• Management of agency partners and budget

• Crisis and issues management

• Pharmaceutical experience preferred

Skills:

• Strategic and critical thinking skills and collaborative mindset​

• Ability to effectively analyze audience and market data to inform communication approach​

• Strong communications abilities including storytelling, writing and presentation skills for Global and US audiences

• Excellent ability to translate difficult to understand science into a clear and differentiated narrative across stakeholders

• Ability to effectively use AI‑enabled tools to support communications planning, content development and insights generation - consistent with enterprise standards - to realize efficiencies

• Ability to understand and predict the impact of communications strategies on brand and organizational goals​

• Ability to manage and implement integrated (multi-audience, multi-channel) communication plans, campaigns and projects against business objectives and priorities, and measure effectiveness of efforts

• Ability to multi-task and manage complex issues into simple effective solutions​

• Ability to influence and adapt within a dynamic and ambiguous environment​

• Ability to manage across diverse set of matrixed cross-functional partners

• Ability to prioritize and maximize time and

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
We are looking for a collaborative and scientifically strong professional to take on the role of Formulation Project Leader across late phase oral drug product development programs. In this role, you will lead formulation and manufacturing activities for small‑molecule oral dosage forms, with a strong focus on designing robust formulations, developing scalable processes, and ensuring reliable project delivery.

Working across cross-functional development teams, you will integrate scientific and technical insights to establish coherent development strategies from early clinical phases through scale-up, transfer, and regulatory submission. You will contribute to building a deep understanding of how material attributes, formulation choices, and process parameters drive product performance and manufacturability, and translate this into practical, high-quality development solutions.

You will be accountable for the generation of high-quality technical documentation, the preparation and oversight of manufacturing activities, and the coordination of development efforts to meet project timelines and quality expectations.

In addition to delivering across projects, you will actively contribute to evolving ways of working by applying structured, data-driven approaches and identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, consistency, and knowledge reuse across the portfolio.

Job Description
Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Lead formulation development and manufacturing process activities for oral dosage forms across development phases, with a strong focus on designing robust, scalable formulations and processes and ensuring reliable project delivery.

• Develop and maintain project plans that align formulation, manufacturing, and supply activities with overall program objectives and timelines.

• Generate and integrate scientific insight into how drug substance and ex cipient properties, formulation design, and process parameters influence product performance, manufacturability, and consistency.

• Apply structured, science-based approaches (e.g., quality-by-design, modelling, and digital tools) to enhance understanding, enable informed decision-making, and support consistent and efficient development practices

• Act as a key partner within cross-functional drug product sub-teams, collaborating closely with e.g. Pharmaceutical Development, Chemistry & Analytical Development, technical operations, QA and other relevant functions to ensure aligned and efficient execution.

• Own and contribute to high-quality technical documentation, including development reports, manufacturing instructions, and CMC documentation, and support responses to health authority questions and regulatory inspections.

• Promote effective collaboration and knowledge sharing within and across teams, contributing to continuous improvement in development approaches, efficiency of execution, and reuse of knowledge across projects.

What you’ll bring to the role:

• Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Technology, Powder Process Engineering, or a related scientific field; PhD or equivalent experience is valued.

• Minimum 3+ years of relevant industry experience in solid formulation and/or process development, preferably within pharmaceutical development of oral dosage forms.

• Solid understanding of formulation design, manufacturing process development, scale-up, and process transfer, with a focus on creating robust and reliable processes.

• Experience applying structured experimental and data-driven approaches (e.g., modelling, PAT, DoE, statistical analysis, or related methodologies) to support formulation and process development.

• Strong ability to work across functions, integrate diverse inputs, and drive scientific problem solving in a clear and pragmatic way within multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent communication, scientific writing, and presentation

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
We are looking for a collaborative and scientifically strong professional to bring together formulation project leadership and biopharmaceutic expertise across innovative oral drug product development programs. In this role, you will guide formulation and manufacturing activities for small-molecule oral dosage forms while deepening the understanding of how molecular properties, formulation design, and process parameters influence absorption, bioavailability, and in vivo performance. Working across TRD, PHAD, PK Sciences, Translational Medicine, and development sub-teams, you will help shape integrated, data-driven strategies that support development from first-in-human studies through scale-up, transfer, and regulatory submission.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Lead formulation development and manufacturing process activities for oral dosage forms, from early clinical phases through final formulation and process definition, for Phase 3 and beyond.

• Develop and maintain integrated project plans that connect formulation, control strategy, biopharmaceutic assessments, bridging strategies, and supply activities with overall program objectives.

• Provide scientific insight into the relationship between drug substance properties, dosage form design, dissolution, permeability, absorption, and in vivo performance.

• Design, interpret, and integrate in vitro, in silico, and in vivo biopharmaceutic studies to support formulation selection and development decisions.

• Contribute as a key partner within cross-functional drug product sub-teams and collaborate closely with Pharmaceutical Development, Chemistry & Analytical Development, PK Sciences, Translational Medicine, and technical operations.

• Contribute to scientific documentation and support CMC and development dossiers, including responses to health authority questions and regulatory inspections.

• Apply innovative approaches such as predictive modeling, biorelevant testing, quality-by-design principles, and digital methods to formulation and biopharmaceutic development.

• Share knowledge, support colleagues, and help strengthen scientific capabilities across teams.
What You’ll Bring

• Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related scientific field; PhD or equivalent experience is valued.

• Relevant industry experience in formulation development and/or biopharmaceutics within pharmaceutical development, ideally for small-molecule oral dosage forms.

• Broad understanding of formulation design, manufacturing process development, absorption science, and performance-based drug product development.

• Knowledge and application of amorphous drug product manufacturing processes, formulation design, stability evaluation,

• Experience with technical approaches such as predictive modeling, dissolution and permeability studies, advanced DoE designs, and experimental strategies that support biopharmaceutic understanding, formulation, and process development.

• Familiarity with CMC documentation and GxP environments, including GMP and GLP expectations.

• Ability to work across functions, solve scientific problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong scientific writing, presentation, collaboration, and mentoring skills are an advantage.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion : Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mai

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This is a leadership role for the AI Systems & Scale group within AI4R and will be tasked with strong technical and project leadership, critical assessment and specialized deployment of compute, data, model, code and agentic platforms for rapid enablement and adoption of AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a leadership role shaping the future of AI at scale, where advanced agentic systems and enterprise AI platforms transform how biomedical research is delivered. As Director & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), you will drive the design and deployment of next-Generation AI systems, enabling scientists to seamlessly leverage data, models, and intelligent workflows to accelerate drug discovery. You will lead high-performing engineering teams, define scalable architectures, and ensure AI solutions are robust, governed, and impactful—bringing innovative therapies closer to patients faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the multi-year roadmap for scalable AI systems, platforms, and agentic architectures across research.

• Lead and scale multidisciplinary teams delivering production-grade AI systems and intelligent applications.

• Establish reference architectures for agentic systems, including orchestration, retrieval, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Build and standardize enterprise agentic platforms with reusable components, workflows, and evaluation frameworks.

• Define and enforce machine learning operations and large language model operations standards across AI systems development.

• Own agent quality and safety engineering, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and failure detection mechanisms.

• Drive scalable deployment strategies, ensuring performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and multi-tenant architecture.

• Define performance metrics linking system effectiveness to scientific outcomes, including accuracy, robustness, and efficiency.

• Partner with data, security, and platform teams to ensure governance, compliance, and responsible data usage.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration and portfolio management to prioritize high-impact AI system initiatives and reduce duplication.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience leading machine learning capability development initiatives across multiple drug discovery domains and teams.

• Strong experience applying machine learning across functional areas such as computati

Gamma di insalata: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Descrizione del lavoro Titolo del lavoro: Direttore & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale) #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Supporto di trasferimento: Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile. Novartis ha abbracciato una strategia coraggiosa per guidare una trasformazione digitale a livello aziendale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di posizionare Novartis come leader del settore adottando proattivamente tecnologie digitali che favoriscono approcci innovativi per accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) nell’esplorazione e nell’applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga e per accelerare e migliorare l’efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo è un ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Systems & Scale all'interno di AI4R e sarà incaricato di una forte leadership tecnica e di progetto, valutazione critica e distribuzione specializzata di piattaforme di calcolo, dati, modello, codice e agentic per il rapido abilitamento e l'adozione di approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto su settori chiave di ricerca biomedica che potrebbero portare a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più veloce. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership plasmando il futuro dell'IA a scala, dove sistemi agentici avanzati e piattaforme AI enterprise trasformano come la ricerca biomedica viene consegnata. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), guiderai la progettazione e la distribuzione di sistemi AI di prossima generazione, consentendo agli scienziati di sfruttare senza soluzione di continuità dati, modelli e flussi di lavoro intelligenti per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Potrai condurre team di ingegneria ad alte prestazioni, definire architetture scalabili, e garantire soluzioni AI sono robuste, governate e impattanti, portando terapie innovative più vicine ai pazienti più velocemente. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la roadmap pluriennale per sistemi, piattaforme e architetture agentiche scalabili di AI.
• Lead e scale team multidisciplinari che offrono sistemi AI di qualità produttiva e applicazioni intelligenti.
• Stabilire architetture di riferimento per sistemi agentici, tra cui orchestrazione, recupero, memoria e controlli umani-in-the-loop.
• Costruire e standardizzare piattaforme di agentic aziendali con componenti riutilizzabili, flussi di lavoro e framework di valutazione.
• Definire e far rispettare le operazioni di apprendimento automatico e i grandi standard di gestione del modello di lingua nello sviluppo dei sistemi AI.
• ingegneria della qualità e della sicurezza del proprio agente, compresi i sistemi di controllo, di controllo e di rilevamento dei guasti.
• Guidare strategie di distribuzione scalabili, garantendo prestazioni, affidabilità, efficienza dei costi e architettura multi-tenant.
• Definire le metriche di performance che collegano l'efficacia del sistema ai risultati scientifici, tra cui precisione, robustezza ed efficienza.
• Collabora con i team di dati, sicurezza e piattaforma per garantire la governance, la conformità e l'utilizzo dei dati responsabili.
• Guidare la collaborazione interfunzionale e la gestione del portafoglio per dare priorità alle iniziative di sistema AI ad alto impatto e ridurre la duplicazione. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di machine learning in più domini e team di scoperta della droga.
• Forte esperienza nell'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico in aree funzionali come il calcolo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Gehaltsbereich: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Berufsbezeichnung: Director & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale) #LI-Hybrid Standort: Basel, Schweiz Relocation Support: Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie erreichbar sind. Novartis hat eine mutige Strategie verfolgt, um eine unternehmensweite digitale Transformation voranzutreiben. Unser Ziel ist es, Novartis als Branchenführer zu positionieren, indem wir proaktiv digitale Technologien einsetzen, die innovative Ansätze zur Beschleunigung der Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung fördern. Durch die Nutzung sowohl interner als auch externer F & E-Daten mit der Leistungsfähigkeit von Data Science, prädiktiven Modellen, generativer KI und maschinellem Lernen ist es unser Ziel, neue Ziele zu identifizieren, effektivere therapeutische Moleküle zu erstellen, Arzneimittelpharmakokinetik und Sicherheitsrisiken besser vorherzusagen, das Design klinischer Studien zu verfeinern und Entwicklungszyklen deutlich zu verkürzen. Das AI4R-Team leitet Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) bei der Erforschung und Anwendung fortschrittlicher KI- und ML-Methoden, um neue Erkenntnisse in der Wirkstoffforschung zu generieren und die Effizienz der Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während es sich auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten konzentriert. AI4R arbeitet mit Wirkstoffforschungsteams zusammen, erhöht das Niveau der KI-Expertise in der biomedizinischen Forschung (BR) und stellt sicher, dass die BR-Wissenschaft mit dem sich schnell entwickelnden Ökosystem der KI-Technologien Schritt hält, indem sie sich mit KI-Führungskräften in Wissenschaft und Industrie verbindet. Dies ist eine Führungsrolle für die AI Systems & Scale-Gruppe innerhalb von AI4R und wird mit einer starken technischen und Projektführung, einer kritischen Bewertung und einem spezialisierten Einsatz von Computer-, Daten-, Modell-, Code- und Agentenplattformen für eine schnelle Aktivierung und Übernahme von KI-Ansätzen, Algorithmen, Modellen und Workflows beauftragt, um die Auswirkungen auf wichtige Bereiche der biomedizinischen Forschung zu maximieren, die möglicherweise dazu führen werden, bessere Medikamente schneller zu entwickeln. Stellenbeschreibung Treten Sie in eine Führungsrolle ein, die die Zukunft der KI in großem Maßstab gestaltet, wo fortschrittliche Agentensysteme und KI-Plattformen für Unternehmen die Art und Weise verändern, wie biomedizinische Forschung betrieben wird. Als Director & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale) werden Sie das Design und den Einsatz von KI-Systemen der nächsten Generation vorantreiben, sodass Wissenschaftler Daten, Modelle und intelligente Workflows nahtlos nutzen können, um die Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen. Sie leiten leistungsstarke Engineering-Teams, definieren skalierbare Architekturen und stellen sicher, dass KI-Lösungen robust, verwaltet und wirkungsvoll sind - und bringen innovative Therapien den Patienten schneller näher. • Leitung und Skalierung multidisziplinärer Teams, die produktionsfähige KI-Systeme und intelligente Anwendungen bereitstellen.
• Etablierung von Referenzarchitekturen für agentische Systeme, einschließlich Orchestrierung, Abrufen, Speicher und Mensch-in-the-Loop-Kontrollen.
• Erstellen und Standardisieren von Agentic-Plattformen für Unternehmen mit wiederverwendbaren Komponenten, Workflows und Evaluierungsframeworks.
• Definieren und Erzwingen von maschinellem Lernen und großen Sprachmodellbetriebsstandards für die Entwicklung von KI-Systemen.
• Eigene Agentenqualitäts- und Sicherheitstechnik, einschließlich Leitplanken, Richtliniendurchsetzung und Fehlererkennungsmechanismen.
• Skalierbare Deployment-Strategien vorantreiben und dabei Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit, Kosteneffizienz und Multi-Tenant-Architektur sicherstellen.
• Definieren Sie Leistungskennzahlen, die die Systemeffektivität mit wissenschaftlichen Ergebnissen verbinden, einschließlich Genauigkeit, Robustheit und Effizienz.
• Partnerschaft mit Daten-, Sicherheits- und Plattformteams, um Governance, Compliance und verantwortungsvolle Datennutzung sicherzustellen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 1 46 300,00 CHF - 2 71 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Titre du poste : Directeur et chef de groupe (systèmes et échelle d'IA) #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Soutien à la réinstallation: Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. AI4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, élève le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en connectant les leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Il s'agit d'un rôle de chef de file pour le groupe Systèmes et échelles d'IA au sein de l'IA4R et sera chargé d'un leadership technique et de projet solide, d'évaluation critique et de déploiement spécialisé de plates-formes de calcul, de données, de modèle, de code et d'agent pour permettre rapidement l'adoption d'approches, d'algorithmes, de modèles et de flux de travail d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient conduire à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrer dans un rôle de leadership façonnant l'avenir de l'IA à l'échelle, où les systèmes d'agents de pointe et les plates-formes d'IA d'entreprise transforment la façon dont la recherche biomédicale est réalisée. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (AI-Systems & Scale), vous piloterez la conception et le déploiement de systèmes d'IA de prochaine génération, ce qui permettra aux scientifiques d'exploiter de façon transparente les données, les modèles et les flux de travail intelligents pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Vous dirigerez des équipes d'ingénieurs hautement performantes, définirez des architectures évolutives et veillerez à ce que les solutions d'IA soient robustes, gouvernées et efficaces. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour les systèmes, plates-formes et architectures agentsables évolutives de l'IA dans toute la recherche.
• Des équipes multidisciplinaires de pointe et d'échelle fournissant des systèmes d'IA de qualité de production et des applications intelligentes.
• Établir des architectures de référence pour les systèmes d'agents, y compris l'orchestration, la récupération, la mémoire et les contrôles humains en boucle.
• Construire et normaliser des plateformes d'agents d'entreprise avec des composants réutilisables, des flux de travail et des cadres d'évaluation.
• Définir et faire respecter les opérations d'apprentissage automatique et les grandes normes d'exploitation des modèles linguistiques dans l'ensemble du développement des systèmes d'IA.
• Qualité de l'agent et ingénierie de la sécurité, y compris les garde-corps, l'application des politiques et les mécanismes de détection des défaillances.
• Conduire des stratégies de déploiement évolutives, assurant performances, fiabilité, rentabilité et architecture multi-locataires.
• Définir des paramètres de performance reliant l'efficacité du système aux résultats scientifiques, y compris la précision, la robustesse et l'efficience.
• S'associer avec des équipes de données, de sécurité et de plateforme pour assurer la gouvernance, la conformité et une utilisation responsable des données.
• Encourager la collaboration interfonctionnelle et la gestion de portefeuille pour prioriser les initiatives de systèmes d'IA à impact élevé et réduire les doubles emplois. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée menant des initiatives de développement des capacités d'apprentissage automatique dans plusieurs domaines et équipes de découverte de médicaments.
• Forte expérience d'application de l'apprentissage automatique dans des domaines fonctionnels tels que le calcul

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile della Gestione del Prodotto AI e Consegna dei Programmi
titleByLocale.en: Head, AI Product Management and Program Delivery
titleByLocale.de: Leiterin, AI Product Management und Program Delivery
titleByLocale.fr: Chef, Gestion des produits d'IA et exécution des programmes

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF164,500.00 - CHF305,500.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Multiple Location Opening, please apply to the location preferred.
#LI-Hybrid

The Head, AI Product Management & Program Delivery leads the end-to-end execution of the Development AI product portfolio, ensuring successful delivery from MVP through scale and steady-state operations, with a strong focus on adoption readiness and measurable business value.
The role is accountable for establishing and running a high-performing product management and program delivery system, including operating model, governance, and delivery standards, to ensure consistent, predictable execution across a complex AI portfolio.
In alignment with strategic direction, portfolio priorities, and governance decisions defined by the Head of Development AI and relevant leadership forums, the role translates agreed priorities into integrated product roadmaps, ensuring dependencies, sequencing, and cross-product alignment are actively managed at portfolio level.
.
The role drives coherence and contributes to shaping the product and business capability platform layer across AI solutions, ensuring reuse, rationalization, and consistency of user experience, while aligning with strategy and governance direction.
The role ensures AI products are delivered in a manner that enables adoption, scaling, and integration into business processes, working closely with Line Functions who retain accountability for value realization.
This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for building a high-performing organization and enabling scalable delivery capability across Development.

Job Description
Responsibilities:

• Define and continuously evolve the AI Product Management and Program Delivery operating model, including governance, methodologies (e.g., product lifecycle), and delivery standards across Development

• Ensure high-quality execution of the AI product portfolio against agreed priorities and roadmaps, translating strategic direction into actionable delivery plans

• Establish and maintain strong delivery alignment with LFs, DDIT, and key stakeholders, ensuring clarity on execution ownership, dependencies, and interfaces

• Drive portfolio-level delivery oversight, including progress tracking, risk management, dependency management, and escalation of critical issues

• Lead the mobilization and oversight of cross-functional program structures (e.g., Tiger Teams) for priority AI initiatives, ensuring delivery at pace and scale

• Oversee resource planning and allocation across the AI portfolio, ensuring optimal deployment of product managers, program leads, and delivery capacity

• Monitor execution performance across AI products and programs, ensuring consistency, predictability, and adherence to defined delivery standards

• Ensure AI products are delivered in a manner that enables and embeds business transformation, including integration into workflows, process changes, and new ways of working, in close collaboration with Line Functions.

• Drive cross-product integration and coherence across the portfolio, actively managing dependencies, sequencing, and opportunities for reuse and rationalization at the product and business capability level

• Build and lead a high-performing team of product managers and program delivery leads, fostering strong delivery capability, accountability, and talent development

• Serve as a member of the Process Innovation and AI Leadership Team, contributing to cross-pillar alignment and continuous improvement of the AI operating model

• Oversee external delivery capacity and partners within program execution, ensuring alignment with delivery standards and internal objectives

Requirements:

Education (minimum/desirable):

• Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field

Languages:

• Excellent English required (oral & written)

Experience/Professional requirement:

• Minimum 10 years of ex

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile della Strategia e Governance dell'IA
titleByLocale.fr: Chef, Stratégie d'IA et gouvernance

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF164,500.00 - CHF305,500.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Multiple Location Opening, please apply to the location preferred.
#LI-Hybrid

The Head, AI Strategy & Governance is responsible for maintaining, operationalizing, and continuously improving the Development AI strategy, governance model, and decision-support processes in partnership with the Head of Development AI and senior leadership.
The role enables and drives strategic decision-making for the AI portfolio, ensuring that priorities, investments, and capability evolution are consistently informed by robust competitive intelligence, external benchmarking, and market signals.
Acting as the central strategic integrator across Development, DDIT, and enterprise AI bodies, the role ensures that governance forums, portfolio recommendations, and enterprise interfaces are well-run, evidence-based, and aligned, while final strategy, investment, and governance decisions remain with accountable senior leaders and decision forums.

Job Description
AI Strategy, Competitive Intelligence & Strategic Positioning

• Maintain and evolve the Development AI strategic narrative, planning materials, and strategic priorities in partnership with the Head of Development AI

• Establish and continuously mature a structured competitive intelligence capability (external benchmarking, competitor tracking, regulatory and technology landscape monitoring)

• Synthesize competitive intelligence into actionable strategic insights to support leadership decision-making

• Prepare decision materials enabling leadership trade-offs across AI initiatives based on value, risk, and competitive positioning

• Monitor changes in the external landscape and recommend updates to strategic priorities, assumptions, and focus areas

• Provide clear strategic visibility to senior leadership through structured updates and decision support

AI Portfolio Strategy & Value Governance

• Maintain portfolio prioritization principles, decision frameworks, and evaluation criteria used by leadership to make investment decisions

• Integrate competitive intelligence, external benchmarks, and innovation signals into portfolio recommendations

• Coordinate portfolio reviews and prepare recommendations on priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs

• Maintain the value governance framework, including methods for defining, measuring, and assessing AI impact

• Track and report portfolio-level progress, decision follow-through, and value realization for leadership forums

AI Governance & Risk Oversight (Strategic)

• Maintain and continuously improve the Development AI governance framework, processes, and maturity roadmap in partnership with accountable leaders.

• Ensure alignment of governance approach with enterprise frameworks, regulatory expectations, and Responsible AI standards.

• Monitor governance effectiveness, risk themes, and compliance signals, and escalate issues to accountable decision-makers.

• Clarify governance roles, responsibilities, and forum interfaces to support effective decision-making and accountability

AI Operating Model & Organizational Design

• Maintain and refine the Development AI operating model, including governance processes, decision interfaces, and role clarity

• Document and socialize decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability structures

• Coordinate interfaces across Strategy, Governance, Product & Program Delivery, DSAI, DDIT, and enterprise AI teams

• Recommend operating model improvements to support scale, clarity, and execution effectiveness

Governance Bodies & Enterprise Liaison

• Run and coordinate AI governance forums within Development, including agenda-setting, decision preparation, documentation, and follow-through

• Serve as key liaison to enterprise AI Office, Trailblazer, and company-wide governance bodies

• Coordinate Development inputs into enterprise AI discussions and communicate outcomes back to stakeholders

• Support leadership by ensurin

Salary Range:
CHF102,200.00 - CHF189,800.00

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Senior Specialist Data Science, AI & Quantum
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

At Novartis, you will help shape the future of drug discovery by exploring how quantum computing and advanced data science can unlock new scientific possibilities. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation, biomedical research, and emerging technology, translating cutting-edge methods into meaningful, testable applications that can accelerate how new medicines are discovered and developed. If you are excited by complex scientific challenges, collaborative problem-solving, and the chance to bring breakthrough computational approaches into real-world research, this role offers the platform to make a lasting impact.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI and computational expertise across BR, and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI and advanced computing technologies through engagement with leaders in academia, industry and technology partners.

This role within the Scientific Innovation group of AI4R will focus on pioneering the application of quantum computing and quantum-inspired methods to high value problems in drug discovery and development. The successful candidate will bring scientific depth, practical judgment, and collaborative leadership to identify where quantum approaches may create step-change advantage, and how to translate emerging methods into rigorous, testable scientific use cases. Additionally, the role would be expected to act as the SME liaison of AI4R to BR Disease Areas (DAs) and Function Areas (FAs).

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Identify high-impact opportunities for quantum computing in drug discovery and development

• Evaluate quantum and hybrid approaches against established computational methods

• Design and execute scientifically rigorous proof-of-concept studies

• Apply quantum methods to molecular simulation, optimization, and generative design challenges

• Assess maturity, limitations, and practical applicability of quantum technologies

• Translate complex quantum concepts into clear scientific hypotheses and use cases

• Contribute to defining quantum computing strategy for Biomedical Research

• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to develop reusable workflows and assets

• Act as liaison for quantum initiatives across disease and functional areas

• Promote scientific rigor, reproducibility, and transparency in computational research

Essential Requirements

• Doctoral degree or equivalent experience in quantum computing, physics, computer science, or related quantitative discipline

• Strong understanding of quantum computing algorithms, simulation, and hybrid quantum classical approaches

• Experience applying advanced computational or machine learning methods to scientific or biomedical problems

• Knowledge of drug discovery domains such as molecular simulation, protein modeling, or pharmacokinetics

• Familiarity with quantum computing tools such as Qiskit, Pennylane, Cirq, or similar platforms

• Experience designing and evaluating proof of concept studies with scientific rigor and reproducibility

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear scientific insights and decision frameworks

• Strong collaboration and communication skills across multidisciplinary and external stakeholder groups

Desirable Requirements

• Experience collaborating with academic or industry partners within emerging quantum computing ecosystems

• Familiarity with scaling computational solutions using cloud or high performance computing environments

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile. A Novartis, aiuterà a plasmare il futuro della scoperta della droga esplorando come il calcolo quantico e la scienza dei dati avanzata possono sbloccare nuove possibilità scientifiche. Questa è un'occasione unica per lavorare all'intersezione dell'innovazione, della ricerca biomedica e della tecnologia emergente, traducendo metodi all'avanguardia in applicazioni significative e testabili che possono accelerare come vengono scoperte e sviluppate nuove medicine. Se sei emozionato da complesse sfide scientifiche, problem solving collaborativo, e la possibilità di portare approcci computazionali innovativi nella ricerca nel mondo reale, questo ruolo offre la piattaforma per fare un impatto duraturo. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di intelligenza artificiale e le competenze computazionali in BR e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione dell'AI e le tecnologie avanzate di calcolo attraverso l'impegno con i leader nei partner accademici, industriali e tecnologici. Questo ruolo all'interno del gruppo Scientific Innovation di AI4R si concentrerà sul pioniere dell'applicazione dei metodi di calcolo quantistico e di ispirazione quantistica a problemi di alto valore nella scoperta e nello sviluppo della droga. Il candidato di successo porterà profondità scientifica, giudizio pratico e leadership collaborativa per identificare dove gli approcci quantistici possono creare vantaggio di cambiamento di fase, e come tradurre i metodi emergenti in casi di uso scientifico rigorosi e testabili. Inoltre, il ruolo sarebbe previsto per agire come collegamento PMI di AI4R a aree di malattia BR (DA) e aree funzionali (FA). Descrizione del lavoro Principali responsabilità
• Identificare opportunità ad alto impatto per il calcolo quantistico nella scoperta e nello sviluppo della droga
• Valuta gli approcci quantistici e ibridi contro i metodi computazionali stabiliti
• Progettare ed eseguire studi scientificamente rigorosi
• Applicare metodi quantistici alle sfide di simulazione molecolare, ottimizzazione e progettazione generativa
• Valuta la maturità, le limitazioni e l'applicabilità pratica delle tecnologie quantistiche
• Tradurre concetti quantistici complessi in chiare ipotesi scientifiche e casi di utilizzo
• Contribuire a definire la strategia di calcolo quantistica per la ricerca biomedica
• Collabora con team di ingegneria e piattaforma per sviluppare flussi di lavoro riutilizzabili e risorse
• Agire come collegamento per iniziative quantiche attraverso le malattie e le aree funzionali
• Promuovere rigore scientifico, riproducibilità e trasparenza nella ricerca computazionale Requisiti essenziali
• Grado medico o esperienza equivalente nel calcolo quantico, fisica, informatica o disciplina quantitativa correlata
• Forte comprensione degli algoritmi di calcolo quantistico, della simulazione e degli approcci classici quantistici ibridi
• Esperienza nell'applicazione di metodi di apprendimento computazionale o macchina avanzati a problemi scientifici o biomedici
• Conoscenza dei domini di scoperta della droga come la simulazione molecolare, la modellazione delle proteine o la farmacocinetica
• Familiarità con strumenti di calcolo quantistica come Qiskit, Pennylane, Cirq o piattaforme simili
• Esperienza di progettazione e valutazione della prova di studi di concetto con rigore scientifico e riproducibilità
• Capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in chiari approfondimenti scientifici e quadri decisionali
• Forte capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione tra gruppi di stakeholder multidisciplinari ed esterni Requisiti desiderabili
• Esperienza di collaborazione con partner accademici o industriali all'interno di ecosistemi di calcolo quantico emergenti
• Familiarità con la scalazione di soluzioni computazionali utilizzando ambienti cloud o ad alte prestazioni Ricompense A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere. Il re

Novartis kann keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie erreichbar sind. Bei Novartis werden Sie die Zukunft der Wirkstoffforschung mitgestalten, indem Sie untersuchen, wie Quantencomputer und fortschrittliche Datenwissenschaft neue wissenschaftliche Möglichkeiten erschließen können. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Schnittstelle von Innovation, biomedizinischer Forschung und neuer Technologie zu arbeiten und innovative Methoden in sinnvolle, testbare Anwendungen zu übersetzen, die die Entdeckung und Entwicklung neuer Medikamente beschleunigen können. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Chez Novartis, vous aiderez à façonner l'avenir de la découverte de médicaments en explorant comment l'informatique quantique et les données avancées peuvent libérer de nouvelles possibilités scientifiques. C'est une occasion unique de travailler à l'intersection de l'innovation, de la recherche biomédicale et de la technologie émergente, transformant des méthodes de pointe en applications significatives et testables qui peuvent accélérer la découverte et le développement de nouveaux médicaments. Si vous êtes excité par des défis scientifiques complexes, la résolution de problèmes en collaboration et la chance d'apporter des approches informatiques révolutionnaires dans la recherche réelle, ce rôle offre la plateforme pour faire un impact durable. AI4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, augmente le niveau d'intelligence artificielle et d'expertise informatique dans l'ensemble de la BR, et veille à ce que la science de la BR suive l'évolution rapide de l'écosystème de l'intelligence artificielle et des technologies informatiques de pointe grâce à l'engagement avec les leaders du milieu universitaire, de l'industrie et des partenaires technologiques. Ce rôle au sein du groupe Innovation scientifique de l'IA4R sera axé sur l'application de méthodes de calcul quantique et d'inspiration quantique à des problèmes de grande valeur dans la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Le candidat retenu apportera de la profondeur scientifique, un jugement pratique et un leadership collaboratif pour déterminer où les approches quantiques peuvent créer un avantage de changement d'étape et comment traduire les méthodes émergentes en cas d'utilisation scientifique rigoureuse et vérifiable. De plus, on s'attendrait à ce que ce rôle joue le rôle de liaison entre les PME de l'IA4R et les régions de maladies de BR et les zones de fonctions. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités

Salary Range:
CHF169,400.00 - CHF314,600.00

Job Description Summary
Join us in a high-impact leadership role at the forefront of Oncology drug development.

As Senior Global Program Safety Team Lead, you will bring clinical insight, strategic thinking, and strong leadership to complex safety decisions, helping shape development pathways and advance medicines that could change patients’ lives.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Manage an efficient and successful disease area within the Therapeutic Area (TA)/Development Unit (DU) Medical Safety organization, which provides robust medical and science-driven contribution to BenefitRisk evaluation throughout product lifecycle to enable Novartis to provide impactful medicines to patients worldwide

• Enhance scientific and clinical experience of Medical Safety physicians / scientists through continuous training and coaching. Prepares safety objectives and evaluates and manages performance of the Medical Safety associates within the TA/DU. Identifies talents and high potential associates and is able to defend and discuss in front of leadership team. Together with associates identifies carrier development opportunities and support associates in the carrier path

• Provide expert safety input to the clinical development program for assigned projects/products and be an active member of the Global Program Team (GPT), Global Clinical Team (GCT) and Clinical Trial Team (CTT) -Is responsible for safety issue management from formation of Global Program Team (GPT) through Life Cycle Management

• Responsible for overall signal detection, monitoring, evaluation, interpretation and appropriate management of safety information, based on information from all relevant line functions, post-marketing data, and other sources

• Responsible for documentation/tracking/record keeping of the assigned compounds medical safety activities and for responses to inquiries from regulatory authorities or health care professionals on safety issues

• Leading the preparation of the safety strategy for health authority responses and strategy, in collaboration with other project team members

• Contribute to and often leading the development of departmental and functional/business unit goals and objective

Essential Requirements

• Medical Degree or equivalent (preferred), PhD, PharmD or equivalent graduate level health care professional degree required. Specialty Board certification desirable

• Minimum 5 years clinical experience postdoctoral

• At least 7 years progressive experience in drug development in a major pharmaceutical company (of which 5 years in a global position), including 5 years in safety at a medical position

• Solid expertise in preparing or contributing to preparation of clinical safety assessments and regulatory reports/submissions involving safety information – to include NDA submission documents

• Substantial experience in leading cross-functional, multicultural teams

• Strong experience with (safety or others) issue management

• Extensive experience in drug development, clinical trial methodology, regulatory requirements, scientific methodology, statistics and writing of publication

• Strong leadership skills including coaching; motivating and directing, and fostering teamwork. Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with subordinates, superiors and peers

Languages:

• Fluent English (both spoken and written) is required. Additional languages are an advantage.

Beneficial skills and knowledge:

• Post graduate degree in Pharmaceutical Medicine; Master of Public Health in Epidemiology (or equivalent)

• Strong negotiation and conflict management skills

• Strong experience with medical writing and delivering high quality documents such as RMPs, PSURs

This is your opportunity to lead at the forefront of Oncology development and influence the future of patient safety on a global scale. Apply now to join Novartis and help bring transformative therapies to

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00

Job Description Summary
LI#- Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Therapeutic Area Biomarker Lead (TABL) in the Biomarker Development (BMD) group, you are accountable for defining and delivering biomarker strategies for the Immunology portfolio across multiple drug development programs in early and late clinical stages. You are accountable to translate the preclinical mechanistic understanding into an indication-relevant biomarker strategy, a clinical fit-for-purpose biomarker plan, oversee the integration into the clinical protocol, and lead the scientific and strategic discussions in project teams and governance meetings. As such you are a key member of global project teams, lead the Biomarker and Diagnostic teams, engage in Translational Data Science teams, and provide scientific, strategic, and tactical input aligned to the portfolio.

In the late phase particularly, you will be expected to assume the overall accountability for the biomarker strategy for at least one of our portfolio assets.

Furthermore, you will be leading overarching asset-related biomarker strategies enabling the delivery of late phase assets and respective launches.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• BMD scientific, strategic and tactical leader at project level driving impactful biomarker strategies and supporting biomarker plan excellence with concise communication in project teams and governance meetings.

• Accountable for the biomarker strategy at a project, indication and study level in coordination with the respective clinical study lead and biomarker study expert.

• Lead a dedicated matrixed group of biomarker subject matter experts and project team representatives to align key stakeholders on the biomarker strategy and biomarker plan at the project and study level and across the portfolio.

• Accountable for the concept, endorsement, implementation, delivery and contextualization of the biomarker strategy.

• Contextualizes biomarker results and disseminates conclusions to external audiences via abstracts and/or peer-reviewed publications.

• Co-leads strategic translational data science working groups focused on integrating large-scale molecular and clinical patient data sets to identify novel indications, patient subgroups, and endpoints to enable decision-making.

• Providing thought leadership with other BMD TABLs to identify synergies and drive innovation across our large and diverse clinical portfolio in immunology and general medicine.

• Representing BMD on early and late Disease Area Initiatives or Consortia to identify, develop, and drive disease and compound mechanistic biology, clinical decision-making exploratory biomarkers and precision medicine hypotheses for the portfolio.

• Implementing strategies in close collaboration with the BMD global organization which includes over 100 associates with expertise in all aspects of biomarker science i.e. genetics, genomics, molecular and cellular, digital devices, imaging and data sciences.

Essential Requirements:

• PhD degree in Life Sciences required

• Experience in industry (Pharma or Biotech) for at least 5+ years, working on Clinical Trials.

• Scientific excellence in immunological diseases in the translational and biomarker spaces.

• Relevant expertise utilizing biomarkers for clinical decision-making including pharmacodynamics, clinical efficacy, disease deconvolution, response characterization, patient stratification and/or precision medicine.

• Evidence of interpreting and disseminating omics related findings, e.g. genetics, genomics, proteomics, with relevant application to clinical decision making while partnering with key stakeholders from research, data sciences and clinical development.

• Scientific excellence supported by recognized high quality publications

• Experience performing similar role within a pharmaceutical/biotechnology research company, clinical research organization or academic medical cent

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata: CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00 Descrizione del lavoro LI#- Hybrid Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Come Area terapeutica Biomarker Lead (TABL) nel gruppo Biomarker Development (BMD), sei responsabile per la definizione e la fornitura di strategie di biomarcatore per il portafoglio di Immunology attraverso più programmi di sviluppo della droga nelle fasi cliniche iniziali e tardive. Siete responsabili di tradurre la comprensione meccanistica preclinica in una strategia di biomarcatore di riferimento, un piano clinico fit-for-purpose biomarker, supervisionare l'integrazione nel protocollo clinico, e condurre le discussioni scientifiche e strategiche in team di progetto e incontri di governance. In quanto tale sei un membro chiave dei team di progetto globali, guidare i team Biomarker e Diagnostic, impegnarsi in team di Translational Data Science e fornire input scientifici, strategici e tattici allineati al portafoglio. Nella fase avanzata, in particolare, si prevede di assumere la responsabilità generale per la strategia biomarcatrice per almeno uno dei nostri asset portafoglio. Inoltre, sarete leader overarching strategie di biomarcazione relative agli asset che permettono la consegna di attività di fase tardiva e rispettivi lanci. Descrizione del lavoro Responsabilità chiave:
• Leader scientifico, strategico e tattico di BMD a livello di progetto, guidando strategie di biomarcatore di impatto e sostenendo l'eccellenza del piano di biomarcatore con la comunicazione concisa in team di progetto e incontri di governance.
• Contabile per la strategia di biomarcatore a un livello di progetto, indicazione e studio in coordinamento con il rispettivo direttore di studio clinico e esperto di studi biomarcatori.
• Guidare un gruppo dedicato di esperti di materia biomarcatrice e rappresentanti del team di progetto per allineare i principali stakeholder sulla strategia di biomarcatore e il piano biomarcatore a livello di progetto e di studio e in tutto il portafoglio.
• Contabile per il concetto, l'approvazione, l'attuazione, la consegna e la contestualizzazione della strategia del biomarcatore.
• Contextualizza i risultati del biomarcatore e diffonde le conclusioni al pubblico esterno attraverso astratti e/o pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• Co-promuovere i gruppi di lavoro strategici di scienza dei dati traduttivi focalizzati sull'integrazione di dati molecolari e clinici su larga scala per identificare nuove indicazioni, sottogruppi dei pazienti e endpoint per consentire il processo decisionale.
• Fornire leadership di pensiero con altri TABL BMD per identificare sinergie e guidare l'innovazione attraverso il nostro ampio e diversificato portafoglio clinico in immunologia e medicina generale.
• Rappresentando BMD sulle Iniziative o Consorzi di Area Malattia precoce e tarda per identificare, sviluppare e guidare la malattia e la biologia meccanistica composta, biomarcatori esplorativi decisionali clinici e ipotesi di medicina di precisione per il portafoglio.
• Implementare strategie in stretta collaborazione con l'organizzazione globale BMD che comprende oltre 100 associati con competenze in tutti gli aspetti della scienza dei biomarcatori, cioè genetica, genomica, dispositivi molecolari e cellulari, digitali, immagini e scienze dei dati. Requisiti essenziali:
• Laurea in Scienze della vita necessaria
• Esperienza nell'industria (Pharma o Biotech) per almeno 5 anni, lavorando su processi clinici.
• Eccellenza scientifica nelle malattie immunologiche negli spazi traduttivi e biomarcatori.
• Competenze rilevanti utilizzando biomarcatori per il processo decisionale clinico tra cui la farmacodinamica, l'efficacia clinica, la deconvoluzione delle malattie, la caratterizzazione della risposta, la stratificazione del paziente e/o la medicina di precisione.
• Prove di interpretare e divulgare i risultati relativi omici, ad esempio genetica, genomica, proteomica, con applicazione rilevante al processo decisionale clinico, collaborando con i principali stakeholder della ricerca, delle scienze dei dati e dello sviluppo clinico.
• Eccellenza scientifica sostenuta da pubblicazioni di alta qualità riconosciute
• Esperienza che svolgono un ruolo simile all'interno di una società di ricerca farmaceutica / biotecnologia, organizzazione di ricerca clinica o centro medico accademico

• PhD-Abschluss in Life Sciences erforderlich
• Erfahrung in der Industrie (Pharma oder Biotech) seit mindestens 5+ Jahren, Arbeit an klinischen Studien.
• Wissenschaftliche Exzellenz bei immunologischen Erkrankungen in den Translations- und Biomarkerräumen.
• Relevante Expertise mit Biomarkern für die klinische Entscheidungsfindung, einschließlich Pharmakodynamik, klinischer Wirksamkeit, Dekonvolution der Krankheit, Reaktionscharakterisierung, Patientenschichtung und / oder Präzisionsmedizin.
• Nachweis der Interpretation und Verbreitung von Erkenntnissen im Zusammenhang mit Omics, z. B. Genetik, Genomik, Proteomik, mit relevanter Anwendung auf die klinische Entscheidungsfindung bei gleichzeitiger Partnerschaft mit wichtigen Interessengruppen aus Forschung, Datenwissenschaften und klinischer Entwicklung.
• Wissenschaftliche Exzellenz unterstützt durch anerkannte hochwertige Publikationen
• Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem Pharma- / Biotechnologie-Forschungsunternehmen, einer klinischen Forschungsorganisation oder einem akademischen medizinischen Cent

Vous êtes responsable de traduire la compréhension mécaniste préclinique en une stratégie de biomarqueur pertinente à l'indication, un plan de biomarqueur clinique adapté à l'usage, superviser l'intégration dans le protocole clinique et diriger les discussions scientifiques et stratégiques dans les équipes de projet et les réunions de gouvernance. À ce titre, vous êtes un membre clé des équipes de projet mondiales, dirigez les équipes de biomarqueur et de diagnostic, participez à des équipes de sciences des données translationnelles et fournissez des contributions scientifiques, stratégiques et tactiques alignées sur le portefeuille. De plus, vous dirigerez des stratégies globales de biomarqueurs liés aux actifs permettant la livraison d'actifs en phase tardive et de lancements respectifs. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités :
• Leader scientifique, stratégique et tactique de la DMO au niveau du projet, qui pilote des stratégies de biomarqueurs efficaces et soutient l'excellence du plan de biomarqueurs avec une communication concise au sein des équipes de projet et des réunions de gouvernance.
• Responsable de la stratégie du biomarqueur à un niveau de projet, d'indication et d'étude en coordination avec le chef de l'étude clinique et l'expert de l'étude du biomarqueur.
• Diriger un groupe d'experts en matière de biomarqueurs et de représentants de l'équipe de projet spécialement matricielle afin d'aligner les principaux intervenants sur la stratégie du biomarqueur et le plan du biomarqueur au niveau du projet et de l'étude et à l'échelle du portefeuille.
• Responsable du concept, de l'approbation, de la mise en oeuvre, de l'exécution et de la contextualisation de la stratégie de biomarqueur.
• Contextualise les résultats des biomarqueurs et diffuse les conclusions à des auditoires externes au moyen de résumés ou de publications évaluées par des pairs.
• Codirige des groupes de travail stratégiques sur les données translationnelles axés sur l'intégration d'ensembles de données moléculaires et cliniques à grande échelle sur les patients afin d'identifier de nouvelles indications, des sous-groupes de patients et des paramètres permettant de prendre des décisions.
• Fournir un leadership de réflexion avec d'autres BMD TABL pour identifier les synergies et stimuler l'innovation dans notre vaste et diversifié portefeuille clinique en immunologie et en médecine générale.
• Représentation de la DMO dans les initiatives ou les consortiums des régions de maladies précoces et tardives pour identifier, développer et stimuler la biologie mécanique des maladies et des composés, la prise de décisions cliniques biomarqueurs exploratoires et les hypothèses de médecine de précision pour le portefeuille.
• Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies en étroite collaboration avec l'organisation mondiale de la BMD, qui comprend plus de 100 associés ayant une expertise dans tous les aspects de la science biomarqueur, c'est-à-dire la génétique, la génomique, la moléculaire et cellulaire, les appareils numériques, l'imagerie et les sciences des données. Exigences essentielles:
• Doctorat en sciences de la vie requis
• Expérience dans l'industrie (Pharma ou Biotech) depuis au moins 5 ans, travaillant sur les essais cliniques.
• L'excellence scientifique des maladies immunologiques dans les espaces translationnels et biomarqueurs.
• Expertise pertinente utilisant des biomarqueurs pour la prise de décisions cliniques, y compris la pharmacodynamique, l'efficacité clinique, la déconvolution de la maladie, la caractérisation de la réponse, la stratification du patient et/ou la médecine de précision.
• Preuve de l'interprétation et de la diffusion des résultats liés à l'omique, p. ex. génétique, génomique, protéomique, avec application pertinente à la prise de décision clinique tout en collaborant avec des intervenants clés de la recherche, des sciences des données et du développement clinique.
• Excellence scientifique soutenue par des publications reconnues de haute qualité
• Expérience dans le cadre d'un rôle semblable au sein d'une entreprise de recherche pharmaceutique ou en biotechnologie, d'un organisme de recherche clinique ou d'un centre médical universitaire

Salary Range:
CHF102,200.00 - CHF189,800.00

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Senior Expert (AI Engineering)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Imagine shaping how breakthrough medicines are discovered by bringing cutting-edge AI from concept to real-world application. As a Senior Expert in AI-Engineering, you will sit at the critical intersection of innovation and delivery—transforming advanced machine learning models into scalable, reliable solutions that accelerate drug discovery. Collaborating with leading scientists and AI experts, you will drive the translation of pioneering research into impactful tools, ensuring models are reproducible, efficient, and ready to solve complex biomedical challenges. This is an opportunity to directly influence how modern AI reshapes scientific discovery and improves patient outcomes.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Design and train advanced machine learning models for drug discovery, including deep learning and graph-based architectures

• Own end-to-end model lifecycle from problem definition to production deployment and continuous improvement

• Conduct rigorous benchmarking, validation, and performance evaluation against scientific and business objectives

• Deploy scalable, reliable model inference services meeting latency, throughput, and cost requirements

• Build automated training, retraining, and monitoring pipelines including model drift detection mechanisms

• Optimize models and pipelines for performance, reliability, and scalability across production environments

• Establish and promote engineering best practices for reproducibility, testing, and deployment standards

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate research innovations into production-ready AI solutions

• Partner with scientific experts to validate models against biological and chemical benchmarks

• Mentor teams and contribute to raising engineering excellence across the AI for Research organization

Essential Requirements

• Minimum four years of experience building, training, and deploying machine learning models with measurable real-world impact

• Deep proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX; expertise in model design and optimization

• Proven experience fine-tuning and deploying large pre-trained and foundation models including language and scientific models

• Strong understanding of model evaluation including benchmarking, cross-validation, and performance across data distributions

• Experience with distributed training and large-scale computing environments for high-performance model training

• Hands-on expertise optimizing models and pipelines for latency, throughput, cost, and production performance

• Experience with MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility, and cloud deployment

• Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills with ability to drive engineering excellence in complex environments

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:
Basel: Total Base Pay Range: 102,200.00 - 189,800.00 CHF Annual

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

• Esperienza comprovata messa a punto e distribuzione di grandi modelli pre-formati e di fondazione, tra cui i modelli linguistici e scientifici

• Esperienza con formazione distribuita e ambienti di calcolo su larga scala per la formazione di modelli ad alte prestazioni
• Competenze manuali ottimizzando modelli e tubazioni per la latenza, la produttività, i costi e le prestazioni di produzione
• Esperienza con le pratiche MLOps tra cui il monitoraggio degli esperimenti, la versione del modello, la riproducibilità e la distribuzione del cloud
• Forte capacità di problem solving, collaborazione e comunicazione con la capacità di guidare l'eccellenza ingegneristica in ambienti complessi Ricompense A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Imaginez comment les médicaments révolutionnaires sont découverts en apportant l'IA de pointe du concept à l'application réelle. En tant qu'expert principal en ingénierie de l'IA, vous vous retrouverez à l'intersection critique de l'innovation et de la prestation, transformant des modèles d'apprentissage automatique avancés en solutions évolutives et fiables qui accélèrent la découverte de médicaments. En collaboration avec des scientifiques de premier plan et des spécialistes de l'intelligence artificielle, vous dirigerez la traduction de la recherche pionnière en outils efficaces, garantissant que les modèles sont reproductibles, efficaces et prêts à relever des défis biomédicaux complexes. C'est l'occasion d'influencer directement la façon dont l'IA moderne remodele la découverte scientifique et améliore les résultats des patients. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Concevoir et former des modèles avancés d'apprentissage automatique pour la découverte de drogues, y compris l'apprentissage profond et les architectures basées sur des graphiques
• Cycle de vie du modèle de bout en bout, de la définition du problème au déploiement de la production et à l'amélioration continue
• Effectuer une analyse comparative rigoureuse, une validation et une évaluation du rendement par rapport aux objectifs scientifiques et opérationnels
• Déployer des services d'inférence de modèles évolutifs et fiables répondant aux besoins en matière de latence, de débit et de coûts
• Créer des pipelines automatisés de formation, de recyclage et de surveillance, y compris des modèles de mécanismes de détection de la dérive
• Optimiser les modèles et les pipelines pour la performance, la fiabilité et l'évolutivité dans tous les environnements de production
• Établir et promouvoir les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie pour la reproductibilité, les essais et les normes de déploiement
• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour traduire les innovations de recherche en solutions d'IA prêtes à la production
• Partenariat avec des experts scientifiques pour valider les modèles par rapport aux repères biologiques et chimiques
• Mentor équipe et contribue à l'amélioration de l'excellence en génie dans l'ensemble de l'organisme de recherche AI Exigences essentielles
• Au moins quatre ans d'expérience dans la construction, la formation et le déploiement de modèles d'apprentissage automatique avec un impact réel mesurable
• Compétence approfondie en Python et cadres tels que PyTorch ou JAX; expertise en conception et optimisation de modèles
• Expérience éprouvée en affinage et en déploiement de grands modèles pré-formés et de base, y compris des modèles linguistiques et scientifiques
• Une bonne compréhension de l'évaluation des modèles, y compris l'analyse comparative, la validation croisée et le rendement dans les distributions de données
• Expérience de la formation distribuée et des environnements informatiques à grande échelle pour la formation de modèles à haute performance
• Expertise pratique optimisant les modèles et les pipelines pour la latence, le débit, le coût et les performances de production
• Expérience des pratiques MLOps, y compris le suivi des expériences, la version de modèles, la reproductibilité et le déploiement dans le cloud
