Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (Applied AI)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads BR in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This leadership role for the  Applied AI group of AI4R will be tasked with strong technical, team and project leadership, aligning with biomedical subject matter experts to deeply understand ML opportunities in drug discovery, assessment of the model landscape, leading model benchmarking, and applying the right AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a pivotal leadership role at the forefront of scientific innovation, where cutting-edge artificial intelligence meets biomedical research. As Director & Group Head (Applied AI), you will shape how advanced machine learning approaches accelerate drug discovery, translating complex data into meaningful scientific insights that can transform patient outcomes. You will lead high-impact collaborations, guide strategic AI direction across research domains, and empower teams to push the boundaries of what is possible in developing better medicines, faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the applied artificial intelligence strategy and multi-year roadmap across drug discovery research.

• Align priorities with portfolio needs, scientific opportunities, and measurable business and research impact.

• Lead multidisciplinary teams to identify, prototype, benchmark, and deploy fit-for-purpose artificial intelligence solutions.

• Govern an applied artificial intelligence portfolio with clear intake, prioritization, resourcing, delivery oversight, and success metrics.

• Establish best practices for problem framing, data readiness, benchmarking, evaluation design, and reproducible model development.

• Drive benchmarking of foundation and task-specific models, enabling transparent trade-offs and informed adoption decisions.

• Partner with engineering teams to scale solutions and embed them into day-to-day scientific decision making.

• Define rigorous evaluation metrics linking model performance to downstream decisions and experimental outcomes.

• Build a culture of scientific rigor, rapid iteration, mentorship, and practical impact across teams.

• Forge strategic academic and industry collaborations to accelerate innovation, benchmarking, and technology transfer.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience in leading core machine learning capability development initiatives across drug discovery teams and use cases.

• Proven experience with foundation model benchmarking in drug discovery applications.

• Hands-on experience applying machine learning

Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce BR nell'esplorazione e nell'applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga, e per accelerare e migliorare l'efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Applicato di AI4R sarà affidato a una forte leadership tecnica, di squadra e di progetto, allineando con gli esperti di materia biomedica per comprendere profondamente le opportunità ML nella scoperta della droga, valutazione del paesaggio del modello, benchmarking del modello di leader, e applicando i giusti approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto sulle aree chiave di ricerca biomedica che potenzialmente porteranno a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più velocemente. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'avanguardia nell'innovazione scientifica, dove l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia incontra la ricerca biomedica. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI), formerai come approcci avanzati di machine learning accelerano la scoperta dei farmaci, traducendo dati complessi in approfondimenti scientifici significativi che possono trasformare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai condurre collaborazioni ad alto impatto, guidare la direzione strategica AI attraverso i domini di ricerca, e rafforzare i team di spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile nello sviluppo di farmaci migliori, più veloce. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la strategia di intelligenza artificiale applicata e roadmap pluriennale attraverso la ricerca di scoperta della droga.
• Allineare le priorità con le esigenze del portafoglio, le opportunità scientifiche e l'impatto commerciale e di ricerca misurabile.
• Leader team multidisciplinari per identificare, prototipo, benchmark e distribuire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale fit-for-purpose.
• Governare un portafoglio di intelligenza artificiale applicato con l'assunzione chiara, la priorità, la risonanza, la supervisione della consegna e le metriche di successo.
• Stabilire le migliori pratiche per la definizione dei problemi, la disponibilità dei dati, il benchmarking, la progettazione della valutazione e lo sviluppo del modello riproducibile.
• Promuovere il benchmarking delle fondazioni e dei modelli specifici per le attività, consentendo scambi trasparenti e decisioni di adozione informate.
• Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per scalare le soluzioni e incorporarle nel processo decisionale scientifico quotidiano.
• Definire metriche di valutazione rigorose che collegano le prestazioni del modello a decisioni a valle e risultati sperimentali.
• Costruire una cultura del rigore scientifico, rapida iterazione, mentorship e impatto pratico tra le squadre.
• Forge collaborazioni accademiche e industriali strategiche per accelerare innovazione, benchmarking e trasferimento tecnologico. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di apprendimento delle macchine principali tra i team di scoperta della droga e casi di utilizzo.
• Esperienza dimostrata con il modello di base benchmarking nelle applicazioni di scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza pratica sull'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico

Unser Ziel ist es, Novartis als Branchenführer zu positionieren, indem wir proaktiv digitale Technologien einsetzen, die innovative Ansätze zur Beschleunigung der Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung fördern. Durch die Nutzung sowohl interner als auch externer F & E-Daten mit der Leistungsfähigkeit von Data Science, prädiktiven Modellen, generativer KI und maschinellem Lernen ist es unser Ziel, neue Ziele zu identifizieren, effektivere therapeutische Moleküle zu erstellen, Arzneimittelpharmakokinetik und Sicherheitsrisiken besser vorherzusagen, das Design klinischer Studien zu verfeinern und Entwicklungszyklen deutlich zu verkürzen. Das AI4R-Team leitet BR bei der Erforschung und Anwendung fortschrittlicher KI- und ML-Methoden, um neue Erkenntnisse in der Wirkstoffforschung zu generieren und die Effizienz der Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während es sich auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten konzentriert. AI4R arbeitet mit Wirkstoffforschungsteams zusammen, erhöht das Niveau der KI-Expertise in der biomedizinischen Forschung (BR) und stellt sicher, dass die BR-Wissenschaft mit dem sich schnell entwickelnden Ökosystem der KI-Technologien Schritt hält, indem sie sich mit KI-Führungskräften in Wissenschaft und Industrie verbindet. Diese Führungsrolle für die Applied AI-Gruppe von AI4R wird mit einer starken technischen, Team- und Projektführung beauftragt, die sich mit biomedizinischen Fachexperten zusammensetzt, um die ML-Möglichkeiten in der Wirkstoffforschung, der Bewertung der Modelllandschaft, der Leitung des Modell-Benchmarkings und der Anwendung der richtigen KI-Ansätze, Algorithmen, Modelle und Workflows zu verstehen und die Auswirkungen auf wichtige Bereiche der biomedizinischen Forschung zu maximieren, die möglicherweise dazu führen werden Entwicklung besserer Medikamente, schneller. Stellenbeschreibung Treten Sie in eine zentrale Führungsrolle an der Spitze der wissenschaftlichen Innovation ein, wo innovative künstliche Intelligenz auf biomedizinische Forschung trifft. Als Director & Group Head (Applied AI) gestalten Sie, wie fortschrittliche maschinelle Lernansätze die Wirkstoffforschung beschleunigen und komplexe Daten in sinnvolle wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse übersetzen, die die Patientenergebnisse verändern können. Sie werden einflussreiche Kooperationen leiten, die strategische KI-Richtung über Forschungsbereiche hinweg lenken und Teams befähigen, die Grenzen dessen, was bei der Entwicklung besserer Medikamente möglich ist, schneller zu überschreiten. • Definieren und leiten Sie die angewandte Strategie für künstliche Intelligenz und die mehrjährige Roadmap für die Wirkstoffforschung.
• Ausrichtung der Prioritäten auf Portfolioanforderungen, wissenschaftliche Möglichkeiten und messbare Auswirkungen auf Unternehmen und Forschung.
• Führen Sie multidisziplinäre Teams an, um Lösungen für künstliche Intelligenz zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln, zu vergleichen und einzusetzen.
• Leiten Sie ein Portfolio für angewandte künstliche Intelligenz mit klaren Annahme-, Priorisierungs-, Resourcing-, Lieferaufsichts- und Erfolgsmetriken.
• Etablieren Sie Best Practices für Problemrahmen, Datenbereitschaft, Benchmarking, Bewertungsdesign und reproduzierbare Modellentwicklung.
• Förderung des Benchmarkings von Stiftungs- und aufgabenspezifischen Modellen, um transparente Kompromisse und fundierte Adoptionsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieurteams, um Lösungen zu skalieren und sie in die tägliche wissenschaftliche Entscheidungsfindung einzubetten.
• Definieren Sie strenge Bewertungsmetriken, die die Modellleistung mit nachgelagerten Entscheidungen und experimentellen Ergebnissen verbinden.
• Bauen Sie eine Kultur der wissenschaftlichen Strenge, schnellen Iteration, Mentoring und praktischen Auswirkungen in allen Teams auf.
• Schmieden Sie strategische akademische und industrielle Kooperationen, um Innovation, Benchmarking und Technologietransfer zu beschleunigen. Grundlegende Anforderungen
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in führenden Kernentwicklungsinitiativen für maschinelles Lernen in Wirkstoffforschungsteams und Anwendungsfällen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Foundation Model Benchmarking in Wirkstoffforschungsanwendungen.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen

En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. Salary Range:
CHF102,200.00 - CHF189,800.00

Job Description Summary
The Senior Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team within the Translational Medicine Unit to help advance data-driven drug discovery. The role is focused on transforming large-scale ADME, PK, and related experimental datasets into actionable insights through advanced analytics, machine learning, and robust software engineering. Partnering closely with pharmacokinetic sciences (PKS) scientists, Data & Digital teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, this position will drive the development of scalable analytical applications, reusable computational workflows, and decision-enabling in silico solutions that accelerate lead optimization and strengthen scientific decision making.

Job Description
200+ experimental datasets are generated every day in the Pharmacokinetic Sciences (PKS) department at Novartis Biomedical Research. This role sits at the center of efforts to unlock the value of these data for decision making and to shape the future of medicine through advanced data science.
As Associate Director Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, you will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team in the Translational Medicine Unit and work at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and drug discovery. You will apply machine learning, statistics, and modern software development practices to harness ADME and PK data, uncover structure–property relationships, and translate scientific and business needs into scalable, strategically aligned solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Data & Digital and PKS wet- (ADME and bioanalytical) and dry-lab (modeling) teams to identify opportunities where data, applications, and in silico methods can meaningfully improve decision quality, efficiency, and scientific impact. In addition to hands-on technical delivery, you will help shape and champion fit-for-purpose solutions that are robust, reusable, and maintainable in a production setting.
This role is ideal for a scientifically grounded data leader who combines strong analytical depth with practical software engineering expertise, and who is motivated by delivering measurable impact in drug discovery through high-quality data products, machine learning, and computational innovation.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key Modeling & Simulation Data Science representative on discovery and lead optimization programs, contributing scientific and strategic input to project discussions and decisions.

• Partner with Data & Digital and PKS wet- and dry-lab teams to identify priority gaps, clarify business needs, and translate them into high-impact analytical and computational solutions.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, workflows, and data pipelines that support scientific analysis and decision making across projects and modalities.

• Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and statistical models to uncover relationships between chemical structure and molecular or pharmacokinetic properties.

• Apply data mining, visualization, and exploratory analysis to derive insight from complex experimental datasets and communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

• Create and implement project- or modality-specific in silico models and data strategies that accelerate and streamline compound progression decisions.

• Write production-quality code following strong software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and maintainability standards.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives spanning data science, software engineering, and laboratory teams, ensuring delivery of fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Promote the adoption and effective use of in-house tools, applications, and data science methods to maximize impact across Translational Medicine and PKS.

• Stay current with advances in AI/ML, statistics, and computational

Gamma di insalata: CHF102,200.00 - CHF189,800.00 Descrizione del lavoro Il Senior Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer si unirà al team di Modeling & Simulation Data Science all'interno dell'Unità di Medicina Traduttiva per aiutare ad avanzare la scoperta di farmaci generati dai dati. Il ruolo è focalizzato sulla trasformazione di grandi dimensioni ADME, PK e relativi set di dati sperimentali in insight attuabili attraverso analisi avanzate, machine learning e robusta ingegneria del software. Collaborando a stretto contatto con le scienze farmacocinetiche (PKS) scienziati, team Data & Digital e stakeholder interfunzionali, questa posizione guiderà lo sviluppo di applicazioni analitiche scalabili, flussi di lavoro computazionali riutilizzabili e soluzioni decisionali in silico che accelerano l'ottimizzazione dei lead e rafforzano il processo decisionale scientifico. Descrizione del lavoro 200+ dataset sperimentali vengono generati ogni giorno nel dipartimento di Scienze Farmacocinetiche (PKS) di Novartis Biomedical Research. Questo ruolo si trova al centro degli sforzi per sbloccare il valore di questi dati per il processo decisionale e per modellare il futuro della medicina attraverso la scienza dei dati avanzata. Come Direttore associato Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, si unirà al team di Modeling & Simulation Data Science nell'unità di Medicina Traduttiva e lavorare all'intersezione di scienza dei dati, ingegneria del software e scoperta della droga. Si applicherà l'apprendimento automatico, le statistiche e le pratiche di sviluppo software moderne per sfruttare i dati ADME e PK, scoprire le relazioni struttura-proprietà, e tradurre le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni scalabili, strategicamente allineate. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team Data & Digital e PKS bagnato- (ADME e bioanalitico) e Dry-lab (modello) per identificare le opportunità in cui dati, applicazioni e metodi silico possono migliorare significativamente la qualità delle decisioni, l'efficienza e l'impatto scientifico. Oltre alla consegna tecnica pratica, vi aiuterà a modellare e campione soluzioni fit-for-purpose che sono robuste, riutilizzabili e manutenbili in un ambiente di produzione. Questo ruolo è ideale per un leader di dati scientificamente fondato che combina una forte profondità analitica con competenze pratiche di ingegneria del software, e che è motivato da fornire un impatto misurabile nella scoperta della droga attraverso prodotti di dati di alta qualità, machine learning e innovazione computazionale. Principali responsabilità
• Atto come un rappresentante chiave della Modeling & Simulation Data Science sulla scoperta e sui programmi di ottimizzazione dei lead, contribuendo all'ingresso scientifico e strategico per le discussioni e le decisioni del progetto.
• Partner con i team Data & Digital e PKS bagnati e a secco per identificare lacune prioritarie, chiarire le esigenze aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni analitiche e computazionali ad alto impatto.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di applicazioni scalabili, flussi di lavoro e datadotti che supportano l'analisi scientifica e il processo decisionale in progetti e modalità.
• Sviluppare, valutare e distribuire modelli di machine learning e statistici per scoprire le relazioni tra struttura chimica e proprietà molecolari o farmacocinetiche.
• Applicare l'estrazione dati, la visualizzazione e l'analisi esplorativa per ricavare informazioni da complessi dataset sperimentali e comunicare risultati chiaramente a diversi stakeholder.
• Creare e implementare progetti o modalità specifiche in modelli silico e strategie di dati che accelerano e razionalizzano le decisioni di progressione dei composti.
• Scrivere codice di qualità della produzione seguendo forti pratiche di ingegneria del software, tra cui il controllo della versione, test, documentazione e standard di manutenbilità.
• Condurre o contribuire a iniziative interfunzionali che coinvolgono la scienza dei dati, l'ingegneria del software e i team di laboratorio, garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni fit-for-purpose.
• Promuovere l'adozione e l'uso efficace di strumenti interni, applicazioni e metodi di scienza dei dati per massimizzare l'impatto su Medicina Traduttiva e PKS.
• Soggiorna corrente con progressi in AI/ML, statistiche e computazionali

Gehaltsbereich: CHF 102.200.00 - CHF 189.800.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Der Senior Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer wird dem Team von Modeling & Simulation Data Science innerhalb der Translational Medicine Unit beitreten, um die datengesteuerte Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben. Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Umwandlung großer ADME-, PK- und verwandter experimenteller Datensätze in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse durch fortschrittliche Analysen, maschinelles Lernen und robustes Software-Engineering. Durch die enge Partnerschaft mit Wissenschaftlern der Pharmakokinetik (PKS), Data & Digital-Teams und funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern wird diese Position die Entwicklung skalierbarer analytischer Anwendungen, wiederverwendbarer Computer-Workflows und Entscheidungsfindung in silico-Lösungen vorantreiben, die die Lead-Optimierung beschleunigen und die wissenschaftliche Entscheidungsfindung stärken. Stellenbeschreibung Über 200 experimentelle Datensätze werden täglich in der Abteilung für Pharmakokinetische Wissenschaften (PKS) von Novartis Biomedical Research generiert. Diese Rolle steht im Mittelpunkt der Bemühungen, den Wert dieser Daten für die Entscheidungsfindung zu erschließen und die Zukunft der Medizin durch fortschrittliche Datenwissenschaft zu gestalten. Als Associate Director Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer treten Sie dem Team Modeling & Simulation Data Science in der Translational Medicine Unit bei und arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Data Science, Software Engineering und Drug Discovery. Sie werden maschinelles Lernen, Statistiken und moderne Softwareentwicklungspraktiken anwenden, um ADME- und PK-Daten zu nutzen, Struktur-Eigentums-Beziehungen aufzudecken und wissenschaftliche und geschäftliche Anforderungen in skalierbare, strategisch ausgerichtete Lösungen zu übersetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Data & Digital und PKS nass (ADME und bioanalytisch) und Trockenlabor (Modellierung) Teams zusammen, um Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, in denen Daten, Anwendungen und In-silico-Methoden die Entscheidungsqualität, Effizienz und wissenschaftliche Auswirkungen signifikant verbessern können. Zusätzlich zur praktischen technischen Lieferung helfen Sie, passgenaue Lösungen zu gestalten und zu fördern, die robust, wiederverwendbar und in einer Produktionsumgebung wartbar sind. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen wissenschaftlich fundierten Datenführer, der eine starke analytische Tiefe mit praktischem Software-Engineering-Know-how kombiniert und motiviert ist, messbare Auswirkungen auf die Wirkstoffforschung durch qualitativ hochwertige Datenprodukte, maschinelles Lernen und computergestützte Innovationen zu erzielen. • Handeln Sie als wichtiger Vertreter für Modellierung und Simulation Data Science bei Discovery- und Lead-Optimierungsprogrammen und tragen Sie wissenschaftlichen und strategischen Input zu Projektdiskussionen und -entscheidungen bei.
• Partner mit Data & Digital und PKS Nass- und Trockenlaborteams, um vorrangige Lücken zu identifizieren, Geschäftsanforderungen zu klären und sie in wirkungsvolle Analyse- und Rechenlösungen zu übersetzen.
• Entwerfen, erstellen und pflegen Sie skalierbare Anwendungen, Workflows und Datenpipelines, die wissenschaftliche Analysen und Entscheidungsfindung über Projekte und Modalitäten hinweg unterstützen.
• Entwicklung, Bewertung und Einsatz von maschinellem Lernen und statistischen Modellen, um Beziehungen zwischen chemischer Struktur und molekularen oder pharmakokinetischen Eigenschaften aufzudecken.
• Wenden Sie Data Mining, Visualisierung und explorative Analysen an, um Erkenntnisse aus komplexen experimentellen Datensätzen abzuleiten und die Ergebnisse an verschiedene Interessengruppen klar zu kommunizieren.
• Erstellen und implementieren Sie projekt- oder modalitätsspezifische in silico-Modelle und Datenstrategien, die zusammengesetzte Progressionsentscheidungen beschleunigen und rationalisieren.
• Schreiben Sie Code in Produktionsqualität nach starken Software-Engineering-Praktiken, einschließlich Versionskontrolle, Testen, Dokumentation und Wartbarkeitsstandards.
• Führen oder tragen Sie zu funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen bei, die Datenwissenschaft, Software-Engineering und Laborteams umfassen und die Bereitstellung von passenden Lösungen sicherstellen.
• Förderung der Einführung und effektiven Nutzung von internen Tools, Anwendungen und Data Science-Methoden, um die Wirkung von Translational Medicine und PKS zu maximieren.
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit Fortschritten in AI / ML, Statistiken und Computern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : CHF 102,200,00 - CHF 189 800,00 Résumé de la description d'emploi Le chercheur principal en données et ingénieur en logiciels scientifiques se joindra à l'équipe de modélisation et de simulation des données scientifiques au sein de l'Unité de médecine translationnelle pour aider à faire avancer la découverte de médicaments axée sur les données. Le rôle consiste principalement à transformer les ensembles de données ADME, PK et les ensembles de données expérimentaux connexes en données exploitables grâce à des analyses avancées, à l'apprentissage automatique et à une ingénierie logicielle robuste. En étroite collaboration avec les scientifiques en sciences pharmacocinétiques (SCP), les équipes Data & Digital et les intervenants interfonctionnels, ce poste permettra de développer des applications analytiques évolutives, des flux de travail informatiques réutilisables et des solutions silico qui accélèrent l'optimisation du plomb et renforcent la prise de décision scientifique. Description de l'emploi 200 ensembles de données expérimentales sont générés chaque jour dans le département des sciences pharmacocinétiques (PKS) de Novartis Biomedical Research. Ce rôle est au centre des efforts visant à débloquer la valeur de ces données pour la prise de décision et à façonner l'avenir de la médecine grâce à la science avancée des données. En tant que directeur associé Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, vous vous joignez à l'équipe de modélisation et de simulation Data Science de l'Unité de médecine translationnelle et travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, du génie logiciel et de la découverte de médicaments. Vous appliquerez l'apprentissage automatique, les statistiques et les pratiques modernes de développement de logiciels pour exploiter les données ADME et PK, découvrir les relations structure-propriété et traduire les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions évolutives et alignées stratégiquement. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de Data & Digital et PKS wet- (ADME et bioanalytique) et de labyrinthe sèche (modélisation) pour identifier les possibilités où les données, les applications et les méthodes de silico peuvent améliorer significativement la qualité de décision, l'efficacité et l'impact scientifique. En plus de la livraison technique pratique, vous aiderez à façonner et à promouvoir des solutions adaptées à l'usage qui sont robustes, réutilisables et durables dans un cadre de production. Ce rôle est idéal pour un leader scientifique des données qui combine une forte profondeur d'analyse avec une expertise pratique en génie logiciel, et qui est motivé par un impact mesurable dans la découverte de médicaments grâce à des produits de données de haute qualité, l'apprentissage automatique et l'innovation informatique. Principales responsabilités
• Agir en tant que représentant clé de la modélisation et de la simulation des données sur les programmes d'optimisation des découvertes et des chefs de file, en fournissant des contributions scientifiques et stratégiques aux discussions et aux décisions relatives aux projets.
• Faites équipe avec Data & Digital et PKS pour identifier les lacunes prioritaires, clarifier les besoins des entreprises et les traduire en solutions analytiques et informatiques à impact élevé.
• Concevoir, construire et maintenir des applications évolutives, des flux de travail et des pipelines de données qui appuient l'analyse scientifique et la prise de décisions à travers les projets et les modalités.
• Élaborer, évaluer et déployer des modèles d'apprentissage machine et de statistique pour découvrir les relations entre la structure chimique et les propriétés moléculaires ou pharmacocinétiques.
• Appliquer l'extraction de données, la visualisation et l'analyse exploratoire pour obtenir des données expérimentales complexes et communiquer clairement les résultats aux divers intervenants.
• Créer et mettre en œuvre des modèles de silico et des stratégies de données propres à chaque projet ou modalité, qui accélèrent et rationalisent les décisions de progression complexe.
• Écrire un code de qualité de production en suivant de solides pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris le contrôle des versions, les essais, la documentation et les normes de maintenance.
• Diriger ou contribuer à des initiatives interfonctionnelles touchant les données scientifiques, le génie logiciel et les équipes de laboratoire, en assurant la prestation de solutions adaptées à l'usage.
• Promouvoir l'adoption et l'utilisation efficace d'outils, d'applications et de méthodes de science des données internes pour maximiser l'impact de la médecine translationnelle et de la SP.
• Restez à jour avec les avancées en AI/ML, les statistiques et les calculs

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Step into a pivotal role where your leadership can directly shape how breakthrough cardiovascular innovations reach patients worldwide.

International Value & Access Director - Cardio Pipeline, you will set a bold strategic direction, transforming scientific advances into clear, compelling value for payers and healthcare systems. You’ll inspire and unite cross‑functional and country teams, championing access solutions that accelerate affordability, broaden impact, and redefine what’s possible for patients and health systems.

Here, your vision, influence, and enterprise mindset will help build an integrated access strategy that truly moves the needle — for Novartis, for partners, and most importantly, for the people we serve.

This position reports into the Executive Director, V&A CRM.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead creation and execution of integrated international access strategies across the full development‑to‑commercial continuum.

• Shape compelling payer and healthcare‑system value propositions grounded in strong scientific and access‑relevant evidence.

• Represent Access internally and externally, influencing strategic discussions and strengthening Novartis’ international access agenda.

• Embed access insights into Target Product Profiles, clinical plans, and integrated evidence plans to guide asset decision‑making.

• Partner with Commercial Launch Strategy, Pricing, and Therapeutic Areas to co‑create robust international pricing strategies and guidance.

• Ensure timely, high‑quality access input into Integrated Product Strategy, business development assessments, and indication sequencing.

• Collaborate with Health Economics and cross‑franchise teams to align evidence priorities with key market needs.

• Anticipate shifts in priority markets and health‑technology‑assessment archetypes to model future access assumptions and recommendations.

• Build strong cross‑functional and external partnerships to enable innovative, scalable access solutions.

• Champion an enterprise approach, connecting countries and functions to deliver consistent, high‑impact access strategies.

Essential Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in market access roles, including 2+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• CRM product launch experience.

• 2+ years of experience in the relevant therapeutic area.

• Cross functional leadership experience across matrix organization.

• Strong communication skills and ability to influence across a range of diverse stakeholders to drive change.

• Competitive and entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of fostering innovation.

Desirable Requirements:

• 7+ years of experience in market access roles, including 5+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• Strong external network with thought leaders and influencers in the payer and HTA environment.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF220,500.00 - CHF409,500.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

What if the deals you shape today could define the future of healthcare? As Head BD&L Transactions, Immunology, you’ll be at the heart of Novartis’ growth engine—leading high-impact partnerships that bring transformative therapies to patients worldwide. From early research to commercialization, you’ll architect and negotiate complex, global deals, working at the intersection of science, strategy, and business. This is a rare opportunity to influence our immunology pipeline, collaborate with senior leaders, and position Novartis as a partner of choice across the industry.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Architect and negotiate complex licensing and partnering transactions across all development stages

• Drive deal structuring, term sheet development, and contract negotiations with external partners

• Orchestrate cross-functional teams to build strong, data-driven business cases

• Partner closely with Therapeutic Area leadership to align on strategy and priorities

• Navigate governance processes, presenting clear recommendations to senior decision-makers

• Manage internal and external stakeholders to advance deals efficiently and competitively

• Monitor external landscape, identifying partnering opportunities and competitive activity

• Strengthen and leverage an extensive industry network to unlock high-value collaborations

• Champion Novartis as a partner of choice through impactful interactions and deal execution

Essential Requirements

• PhD in Science, ideally combined with a Master of Business Administration or equivalent

• Extensive experience in business development, licensing, or investment banking within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and closing complex partnership deals

• Deep understanding of drug development across research, development, and commercialization stages

• Strong leadership experience managing global, cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with ability to engage senior executives and external partners

Please submit a deal sheet with clear description of the deal and explanation of contribution with your application.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 220.500 - 409.500

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. Job Description Summary
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Program start date: October 1, 2026
Application deadline: July 15, 2026 EOB

Job Description
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Biologics Research Center (BRC) in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
You will join the Cell Line Screening & Development unit, which develops manufacturing CHO cell lines for Novartis’ increasingly complex biotherapeutics pipeline. Working at the interface of research and technical development, you will gain exposure to the early biologics discovery and development process, from molecule design and developability assessment to technical development. Your project will focus on advancing a next-generation CHO platform by evaluating transposon-based gene integration systems. In close collaboration with partners in BRC and Technical Research and Development (TRD), you will contribute to an end-to-end production platform that supports early research through clinical and commercial supply.
To support this work, you will establish high-throughput capabilities for future artificial intelligence/machine learning approaches, from plasmid library design to screening systems with tailored molecule design, and identify multi-specific antibody producers with optimal productivity and quality. You will also apply state-of-the-art genetic characterization to the resulting CHO pools and clones and help generate AI-ready data.

Your work will help advance cell line development technologies and may enable faster, more reliable generation of production cell lines for next-generation biologics.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders and power the future of medicine through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, including the implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network

We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.
This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

Reimagining Medicine Together
At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit pati

Gamma di insalata: CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00 Descrizione del lavoro Siamo entusiasti di invitare le applicazioni per il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, un'opportunità di formazione unica progettata per gli scienziati eccezionali di pronto soccorso desiderosi di affrontare alcuni dei problemi più impegnativi nella ricerca biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Durata: 3 anni Data di inizio programma: 1 ottobre 2026 Termine per la richiesta: 15 luglio 2026 EOB Descrizione del lavoro In qualità di ricerca postdoctoral Fellow, ti unirai a Biologics Research Center (BRC) a Basilea e persegue un progetto di ricerca innovativo all'avanguardia nella scienza biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. Potrai lavorare insieme a scienziati leader in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e multidisciplinare, acquisendo l'esposizione all'ecosistema più ampio che traduce la scoperta scientifica in farmaci. I nostri compagni hanno il potere di porre domande scientifiche audaci, applicare tecnologie all'avanguardia e sviluppare approcci che hanno il potenziale di trasformare la cura del paziente. Opportunità di ricerca Ti unirai all’unità Cell Line Screening & Development, che sviluppa linee cellulari CHO per la pipeline di biotherapeutics sempre più complessa di Novartis. Lavorando all'interfaccia di ricerca e sviluppo tecnico, si otterrà l'esposizione al primo processo di scoperta e sviluppo di biologics, dalla progettazione delle molecole e la valutazione di sviluppo allo sviluppo tecnico. Il vostro progetto si concentrerà sull'avanzamento di una piattaforma CHO di nuova generazione valutando i sistemi di integrazione genica basati su transposon. In stretta collaborazione con i partner di BRC e Technical Research and Development (TRD), contribuirai ad una piattaforma di produzione end-to-end che supporta la ricerca precoce attraverso la fornitura clinica e commerciale. Per sostenere questo lavoro, si istituirà capacità di alto rendimento per futuri approcci di intelligenza artificiale / machine learning, dal design di libreria di plasmide ai sistemi di screening con disegno su misura delle molecole, e identificare i produttori di anticorpo multi-specifici con produttività e qualità ottimali. Potrai anche applicare la caratterizzazione genetica all'avanguardia per i pool e cloni CHO risultante e contribuire a generare dati AI-ready. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà ad anticipare le tecnologie di sviluppo della linea cellulare e può consentire una generazione più veloce e affidabile di linee cellulari di produzione per i biologici di nuova generazione. Perché partecipare al programma? Il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program è progettato per sviluppare la prossima generazione di leader scientifici e il potere il futuro della medicina attraverso una ricerca rigorosa e esperienze di apprendimento immersivo, tra cui l'implementazione di strumenti AI nella ricerca biomedica. I membri della ricerca postdoctoral beneficiano di:
• Guida da leader scientifici e esperti di materia
• Accesso a tecnologie, piattaforme e capacità di ricerca avanzate
• Collaborazione tra discipline e confini organizzativi
• Una comunità globale e diversificata di compagni postdottoriali
• Programmazione dedicata progettata per aiutare gli altri a prosperare durante la loro carriera.
• Opportunità di apprendimento esperienziale personalizzate attraverso un Pratico Postdoc che consente ai compagni di esplorare nuovi domini scientifici, costruire competenze trasversali e espandere il loro impatto oltre il loro progetto di ricerca primaria.
• Opportunità di presentare la ricerca, pubblicare su riviste leader e costruire una rete scientifica internazionale Stiamo entrando in una nuova era di scoperte della ricerca biomedica attraverso la convergenza di biologia, tecnologia e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale, e i compagni sono anche sostenuti nell'impegno con questi approcci emergenti. Questa è una posizione di formazione a tempo pieno fino a tre anni di durata. Reimmaginare la medicina insieme A Novartis, il nostro scopo è quello di riimmaginare la medicina per migliorare ed estendere la vita delle persone. Attraverso questo programma, crescerai come scienziato e futuro leader, contribuendo alle scoperte che possono in definitiva beneficiare pati

Gehaltsbereich: CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Wir freuen uns, Bewerbungen für das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program einzureichen, eine einzigartige Ausbildungsmöglichkeit für außergewöhnliche Nachwuchswissenschaftler, die einige der schwierigsten Probleme in der biomedizinischen Forschung und Wirkstoffforschung angehen möchten. Standort: Basel, Schweiz Dauer: 3 Jahre Startdatum des Programms: 1. Oktober 2026 Bewerbungsfrist: 15. Juli 2026 EOB Stellenbeschreibung Als Postdoktorand werden Sie dem Biologics Research Center (BRC) in Basel beitreten und ein innovatives Forschungsprojekt an der Spitze der biomedizinischen Wissenschaft und Wirkstoffforschung verfolgen. Sie arbeiten mit führenden Wissenschaftlern in einem hochgradig kooperativen, multidisziplinären Umfeld zusammen und sind gleichzeitig dem breiteren Ökosystem ausgesetzt, das wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen in Medikamente übersetzt. Unsere Stipendiaten sind in der Lage, mutige wissenschaftliche Fragen zu stellen, innovative Technologien anzuwenden und Ansätze zu entwickeln, die das Potenzial haben, die Patientenversorgung zu verändern. Forschungsmöglichkeit Sie werden Teil der Cell Line Screening & Development-Einheit, die die Herstellung von CHO-Zelllinien für die immer komplexer werdende Biotherapeutika-Pipeline von Novartis entwickelt. An der Schnittstelle von Forschung und technischer Entwicklung werden Sie dem frühen Biologika-Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsprozess ausgesetzt, vom Moleküldesign und der Bewertung der Entwickelbarkeit bis hin zur technischen Entwicklung. Ihr Projekt wird sich auf die Weiterentwicklung einer CHO-Plattform der nächsten Generation durch die Bewertung transposonbasierter Genintegrationssysteme konzentrieren. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern in BRC und Technical Research and Development (TRD) werden Sie zu einer End-to-End-Produktionsplattform beitragen, die die frühe Forschung durch klinische und kommerzielle Lieferung unterstützt. Um diese Arbeit zu unterstützen, werden Sie Hochdurchsatzfähigkeiten für zukünftige Ansätze der künstlichen Intelligenz / des maschinellen Lernens aufbauen, vom Plasmidbibliotheksdesign bis hin zu Screening-Systemen mit maßgeschneidertem Moleküldesign, und multispezifische Antikörperproduzenten mit optimaler Produktivität und Qualität identifizieren. Sie werden auch modernste genetische Charakterisierung auf die resultierenden CHO-Pools und Klone anwenden und dazu beitragen, AI-fähige Daten zu generieren. Ihre Arbeit wird dazu beitragen, die Entwicklung von Zelllinientechnologien voranzutreiben und eine schnellere, zuverlässigere Erzeugung von Produktionszelllinien für Biologika der nächsten Generation ermöglichen. Warum dem Programm beitreten? Das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program wurde entwickelt, um die nächste Generation von wissenschaftlichen Führungskräften zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Medizin durch strenge Forschung und immersive Lernerfahrungen, einschließlich der Implementierung von KI-Tools in der biomedizinischen Forschung, voranzutreiben. Postdoktoranden profitieren von:
• Anleitung von erfahrenen wissenschaftlichen Führungskräften und Fachexperten
• Zugang zu fortschrittlichen Technologien, Plattformen und Forschungskapazitäten
• Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und organisatorische Grenzen hinweg

Job Description Summary
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Program start date: October 1, 2026
Application deadline: July 15, 2026 EOB

Job Description
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Discovery Sciences in Basel, a multidisciplinary research department advancing target discovery and translational research through innovative science and technology, and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains a significant unmet medical need. This project aims to advance our understanding of mechanisms that influence intestinal tissue function and inflammatory processes by leveraging innovative human-derived experimental systems. The postdoctoral fellow will develop and apply state-of-the-art human organoid and cellular models together with molecular and cellular biology approaches to investigate disease-relevant mechanisms regulating intestinal tissue function and inflammation. These models will be used to improve disease understanding, enable mechanistic studies, and support the discovery and validation of novel therapeutic targets. Working within a highly collaborative and multidisciplinary environment, the fellow will generate insights that contribute to the identification of new therapeutic opportunities for patients with IBD.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders, powering the future of medicine, through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, such as implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated development programs designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network

We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.
This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit patients worldwide.

• Establish human intestinal organoid and epithelial barrier models for IBD research

• Develop assays assessing barrier integrity, inflammatory responses, and multi-omics profiles

• Implement CRISPR-Cas9 genetic perturbations in organoid systems to investigate gene function an

We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Program start date: October 1, 2026
Application deadline: July 15, 2026 EOB

Job Description
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Immunology in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
You will work at the intersection of immunology, AI, and pathology performing advanced spatial analyses of spatial transcriptomics, multiplexed proteomics, and histology data across inflammatory diseases. The goal of the project is to understand how spatially organized immune niches contribute to immune-mediated inflammatory diseases and how they can inform patient stratification and therapeutic discovery. The project will build a harmonized cross-disease atlas of spatial profiling data, benchmark and apply computational methods to annotate tissue structures, and develop AI models to characterize tissue niches across multi-modal spatial data. The expected outcome is a set of standardized spatial datasets, computational tools, and mechanistic hypotheses that reveal shared and distinct inflammatory tissue architectures across immune-mediated inflammatory disease and identify new opportunities for biomarker development, target discovery, and therapeutic interventions.

You will be embedded in a cross-functional team with strong expertise in spatial data analysis, AI model development, and histopathology assessment. You will closely work with scientists within Immunology and AI for Research at Novartis, connect to data scientists across the organization, and to a large PostDoc network. The outcomes of the projects will be disseminated at international conferences and in the form of scientific publications.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders, powering the future of medicine, through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, such as implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

Job Description Summary
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program offers a 3-year 100% position starting October 1, 2026, in Basel, Switzerland, focusing on foundational multimodal proteochemometrics models in drug discovery. This opportunity enables early-career scientists to work with cutting-edge AI and biomedical research technologies in a collaboration with data and wet-lab scientists. The fellows will train and optimize structure affinity models using high-throughput experimental data and evaluate their predictive performance for drug-target interactions in hit finding and and safety assessments.

Job Description
About the Role
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Discovery Sciences in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
Foundational structure activity models that can predict small molecule protein interactions from the small molecule structure and protein sequence have attracted scientific attention. However, the practical suitability of such models trained on public structure activity data has been limited as this data is both low in volume and extremely sparse. Industrial large scale screening technologies such as DNA encoded libraries generate larger volumes of dense data. In this project we aim at training a large- proteochemometrics model based on high-throughput experimental data resulting from different read-out modalities and will assess how such models can be predictive for low-volume high quality affinity data with and without fine-tuning on a small number of such quality data points.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders, powering the future of medicine, through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, such as implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network

We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.
This is a 100% training position of up to three years in duration.

Reimagining Medicine Together
At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Train and optimize

Oktober 2026 eine 3-jährige 100%-Stelle in Basel, Schweiz, die sich auf grundlegende multimodale Proteochemometrische Modelle in der Wirkstoffforschung konzentriert. Diese Möglichkeit ermöglicht es Nachwuchswissenschaftlern, in Zusammenarbeit mit Daten- und Nasslaborwissenschaftlern mit innovativen KI- und biomedizinischen Forschungstechnologien zu arbeiten. Die Stipendiaten werden Strukturaffinitätsmodelle unter Verwendung von experimentellen Hochdurchsatzdaten trainieren und optimieren und ihre prädiktive Leistung für Wirkstoff-Ziel-Interaktionen bei der Feststellung von Treffern und Sicherheitsbewertungen bewerten. Stellenbeschreibung Über die Rolle Wir freuen uns, Bewerbungen für das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program einzureichen, eine einzigartige Ausbildungsmöglichkeit für außergewöhnliche Nachwuchswissenschaftler, die einige der schwierigsten Probleme in der biomedizinischen Forschung und Wirkstoffforschung angehen möchten. Als Postdoc-Fellow werden Sie Discovery Sciences in Basel beitreten und ein innovatives Forschungsprojekt an der Spitze der biomedizinischen Wissenschaft und Wirkstoffforschung verfolgen. Sie arbeiten mit führenden Wissenschaftlern in einem hochgradig kooperativen, multidisziplinären Umfeld zusammen und sind gleichzeitig dem breiteren Ökosystem ausgesetzt, das wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen in Medikamente übersetzt. Unsere Stipendiaten sind in der Lage, mutige wissenschaftliche Fragen zu stellen, innovative Technologien anzuwenden und Ansätze zu entwickeln, die das Potenzial haben, die Patientenversorgung zu verändern. Forschungsmöglichkeit Grundlegende Strukturaktivitätsmodelle, die niedermolekulare Proteininteraktionen aus der niedermolekularen Struktur und Proteinsequenz vorhersagen können, haben wissenschaftliche Aufmerksamkeit erregt. Die praktische Eignung solcher Modelle, die auf Daten zu öffentlichen Strukturaktivitäten trainiert wurden, war jedoch begrenzt, da diese Daten sowohl ein geringes Volumen als auch extrem spärlich sind. Industrielle groß angelegte Screening-Technologien wie DNA-kodierte Bibliotheken erzeugen größere Mengen dichter Daten. In diesem Projekt zielen wir darauf ab, ein großvolumiges Proteochemometriemodell zu trainieren, das auf experimentellen Hochdurchsatzdaten basiert, die aus verschiedenen Auslesemodalitäten resultieren, und werden untersuchen, wie solche Modelle für Affinitätsdaten mit und ohne Feinabstimmung bei einer kleinen Anzahl solcher Qualitätsdatenpunkte prädiktiv sein können. Warum dem Programm beitreten? Das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program wurde entwickelt, um die nächste Generation wissenschaftlicher Führungskräfte zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Medizin durch rigorose Forschung und immersive Lernerfahrungen wie die Implementierung von KI-Tools in der biomedizinischen Forschung voranzutreiben. Postdoktoranden profitieren von:
• Anleitung von erfahrenen wissenschaftlichen Führungskräften und Fachexperten
• Zugang zu fortschrittlichen Technologien, Plattformen und Forschungskapazitäten
• Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und organisatorische Grenzen hinweg
• Eine globale und vielfältige Gemeinschaft von Postdoktoranden
• Dedizierte Programme, die Stipendiaten während ihrer gesamten Karriere helfen sollen.
• Personalisierte Erfahrungslernmöglichkeiten durch ein Postdoc-Praktikum, das Stipendiaten befähigt, neue wissenschaftliche Bereiche zu erkunden, funktionsübergreifendes Fachwissen aufzubauen und ihre Wirkung über ihr primäres Forschungsprojekt hinaus zu erweitern.
• Möglichkeiten, Forschung zu präsentieren, in führenden Zeitschriften zu veröffentlichen und ein internationales wissenschaftliches Netzwerk aufzubauen Wir treten in eine neue Ära biomedizinischer Forschungsdurchbrüche durch die Konvergenz von Biologie, Technologie und Werkzeugen der künstlichen Intelligenz ein, und die Stipendiaten werden auch bei der Beschäftigung mit diesen aufkommenden Ansätzen unterstützt. Dies ist eine 100% Ausbildungsposition von bis zu drei Jahren Dauer. Medizin gemeinsam neu gestalten Bei Novartis ist es unser Ziel, die Medizin neu zu gestalten, um das Leben der Menschen zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Durch dieses Programm werden Sie als Wissenschaftler und zukünftiger Führer wachsen und gleichzeitig zu Entdeckungen beitragen, die letztendlich Patienten weltweit zugute kommen können. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Trainieren und optimieren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00 Sommaire de la description d'emploi Le programme de bourses postdoctorales de recherche biomédicale Novartis offre un poste de trois ans à 100 % à compter du 1er octobre 2026, à Bâle, en Suisse, en mettant l'accent sur les modèles de protéochemométrie multimodale fondamentale dans la découverte de médicaments. Cette occasion permet aux scientifiques en début de carrière de travailler avec des technologies de pointe en matière d'IA et de recherche biomédicale en collaboration avec des scientifiques en laboratoire humide et des chercheurs en données. Les boursiers formeront et optimiseront des modèles d'affinité de la structure à l'aide de données expérimentales à haut débit et évalueront leur rendement prédictif pour les interactions médicamenteuses-cibles dans les évaluations de la détection des accidents et de l'innocuité. Description de l'emploi À propos du rôle Nous sommes heureux d'inviter des candidats au programme de bourses postdoctorales de recherche biomédicale de Novartis, une occasion unique de formation conçue pour les scientifiques exceptionnels en début de carrière désireux de s'attaquer à certains des problèmes les plus difficiles en recherche biomédicale et en découverte de médicaments. En tant que boursier de recherche postdoctorale, vous rejoindrez les Sciences de la découverte à Bâle et poursuivrez un projet de recherche innovateur à l'avant-garde des sciences biomédicales et de la découverte de médicaments. Vous travaillerez avec des scientifiques de premier plan dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et multidisciplinaire tout en vous exposant à l'écosystème plus large qui traduit la découverte scientifique en médicaments. Nos boursiers sont habilités à poser des questions scientifiques audacieuses, à appliquer des technologies de pointe et à élaborer des approches susceptibles de transformer les soins aux patients. Possibilités de recherche Les modèles d'activité de la structure fondamentale qui peuvent prédire les interactions de petites molécules de protéines à partir de la structure de petites molécules et de la séquence de protéines ont attiré l'attention scientifique. Toutefois, la pertinence pratique de tels modèles formés aux données sur les activités de la structure publique a été limitée, car ces données sont à la fois faibles en volume et extrêmement rares. Les technologies industrielles de dépistage à grande échelle, telles que les bibliothèques encodées en ADN, génèrent des volumes plus importants de données denses. Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous visons à former un modèle de protéochemométrie à grande échelle basé sur des données expérimentales à haut débit résultant de différentes modalités de lecture et nous évaluerons comment ces modèles peuvent être prédictifs pour des données d'affinité de haute qualité à faible volume avec et sans réglage fin sur un petit nombre de données de qualité. Pourquoi participer au programme? Le programme de bourses postdoctorales de recherche biomédicale de Novartis vise à développer la prochaine génération de leaders scientifiques, à stimuler l'avenir de la médecine, au moyen de recherches rigoureuses et d'expériences d'apprentissage immersif, comme la mise en oeuvre d'outils d'IA dans la recherche biomédicale. Les boursiers de recherche postdoctorale bénéficient de :
• Orientations de dirigeants scientifiques et d'experts spécialisés
• Accès aux technologies, plates-formes et capacités de recherche de pointe
• Collaboration entre les disciplines et les limites organisationnelles
• Une communauté mondiale et diversifiée de boursiers postdoctoraux
• Programme dédié conçu pour aider les boursiers à prospérer tout au long de leur carrière.
• Des possibilités d'apprentissage expérientiel personnalisées grâce à un stage postdoctoral qui permet aux boursiers d'explorer de nouveaux domaines scientifiques, de développer une expertise interfonctionnelle et d'élargir leur impact au-delà de leur projet de recherche principal.
• Possibilités de présenter des recherches, de publier dans des revues de pointe et de créer un réseau scientifique international Nous entrons dans une nouvelle ère de percées en recherche biomédicale grâce à la convergence des outils de biologie, de technologie et d'intelligence artificielle. Il s'agit d'un poste de formation de 100 % d'une durée maximale de trois ans. Réinventer la médecine ensemble Chez Novartis, notre but est de réimaginer la médecine pour améliorer et étendre la vie des gens. Grâce à ce programme, vous grandirez en tant que scientifique et futur leader tout en contribuant à des découvertes qui pourraient en fin de compte profiter aux patients du monde entier. Principales responsabilités
• Train et optimiser

Job Description Summary
This postdoctoral fellowship offers a unique opportunity to advance the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning for chemical synthesis and reactivity prediction in drug discovery. The successful candidate will develop and apply state-of-the-art predictive models using large-scale reaction datasets to improve chemical decision-making, reaction optimization, and molecular design, while collaborating with experts across data science, computational chemistry, medicinal chemistry, and synthesis technology. The project aims to accelerate the Design–Make–Test–Analyze cycle and contribute to next-generation AI-powered approaches for discovering new medicines.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Program start date: October 1, 2026
Application deadline: July 15, 2026 EOB

Job Description
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program; a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Global Discovery Chemistry in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
Join an interdisciplinary research project at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and synthetic chemistry. This fellowship aims to develop next-generation machine learning approaches that predict chemical reaction outcomes, reaction conditions, and molecular reactivity using large-scale proprietary and public reaction datasets. By leveraging more than two decades of reaction knowledge generated within Novartis, the fellow will investigate how modern AI methods, including graph neural networks, transformer architectures, and foundation models, can improve the efficiency and success rate of chemical synthesis.
The project will focus on building predictive models that help chemists design more efficient synthetic routes, identify optimal reaction conditions, and expand access to diverse chemical space. The fellow will collaborate closely with experts in data science, computational chemistry, medicinal chemistry, and synthesis technology, with opportunities to integrate predictive chemistry models into generative AI workflows and emerging laboratory automation platforms. The research is expected to result in high-impact publications and contribute to accelerating the Design-Make-Test-Analyze cycle in active drug discovery projects.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders, powering the future of medicine, through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, such as implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

Il candidato di successo svilupperà e applicherà modelli predittivi all'avanguardia utilizzando dataset di reazione su larga scala per migliorare il processo decisionale chimico, l'ottimizzazione della reazione e il design molecolare, collaborando con esperti in scienza dei dati, chimica computazionale, chimica medica e tecnologia di sintesi. Il progetto mira ad accelerare il Design–Make–Test– Analizzare il ciclo e contribuire ad approcci AI di nuova generazione per la scoperta di nuovi farmaci. Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Durata: 3 anni Data di inizio programma: 1 ottobre 2026 Termine per la richiesta: 15 luglio 2026 EOB Descrizione del lavoro Siamo entusiasti di invitare le applicazioni per il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program; un'opportunità di formazione unica progettata per gli scienziati eccezionali di pronto soccorso desiderosi di affrontare alcuni dei problemi più impegnativi nella ricerca biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. In qualità di ricerca postdoctoral Fellow, ti unirai alla Global Discovery Chemistry di Basilea e persegue un innovativo progetto di ricerca all'avanguardia nella scienza biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. Potrai lavorare insieme a scienziati leader in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e multidisciplinare, acquisendo l'esposizione all'ecosistema più ampio che traduce la scoperta scientifica in farmaci. I nostri compagni hanno il potere di porre domande scientifiche audaci, applicare tecnologie all'avanguardia e sviluppare approcci che hanno il potenziale di trasformare la cura del paziente. Opportunità di ricerca Unisciti a un progetto di ricerca interdisciplinare all'intersezione di intelligenza artificiale, machine learning e chimica sintetica. Questa borsa mira a sviluppare approcci di apprendimento automatico di nuova generazione che prevedono risultati di reazione chimica, condizioni di reazione e reattività molecolare utilizzando dataset di reazione proprietaria e pubblica su larga scala. Levando più di due decenni di conoscenze di reazione generate all'interno di Novartis, il compagno studierà come i moderni metodi di AI, tra cui reti neurali di grafi, architetture di trasformatori e modelli di fondazione, possono migliorare l'efficienza e il tasso di successo della sintesi chimica. Il progetto si concentrerà sulla costruzione di modelli predittivi che aiutano i chimici a progettare percorsi sintetici più efficienti, identificare le condizioni di reazione ottimali e espandere l'accesso a diversi spazi chimici. Il compagno collaborerà a stretto contatto con esperti in data science, chimica computazionale, chimica medica e tecnologia di sintesi, con opportunità di integrare modelli di chimica predittiva in flussi di lavoro AI generativi e piattaforme di automazione di laboratorio emergenti. La ricerca dovrebbe portare a pubblicazioni ad alto impatto e contribuire ad accelerare il ciclo di Design-Make-Test-Analyze nei progetti di scoperta della droga attiva. Perché partecipare al programma? Il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program è progettato per sviluppare la prossima generazione di leader scientifici, alimentando il futuro della medicina, attraverso una ricerca rigorosa e esperienze di apprendimento immersive, come l'implementazione di strumenti AI nella ricerca biomedica. I membri della ricerca postdoctoral beneficiano di:
• Guida da leader scientifici e esperti di materia
• Accesso a tecnologie, piattaforme e capacità di ricerca avanzate
• Collaborazione tra discipline e confini organizzativi
• Una comunità globale e diversificata di compagni postdottoriali
• Programmazione dedicata progettata per aiutare gli altri a prosperare durante la loro carriera.
• Opportunità di apprendimento esperienziale personalizzate attraverso un Pratico Postdoc che consente ai compagni di esplorare nuovi domini scientifici, costruire competenze trasversali e espandere il loro impatto oltre il loro progetto di ricerca primaria.

Le projet sera axé sur l'élaboration de modèles prédictifs qui aideront les chimistes à concevoir des voies synthétiques plus efficaces, à déterminer les conditions de réaction optimales et à élargir l'accès à divers espaces chimiques. Le boursier collaborera étroitement avec des experts des sciences des données, de la chimie computationnelle, de la chimie médicinale et de la technologie de synthèse, avec l'occasion d'intégrer des modèles de chimie prédictive dans des flux de travail générateurs d'IA et des plateformes d'automatisation de laboratoire. La recherche devrait donner lieu à des publications à fort impact et contribuer à accélérer le cycle de conception, de fabrication et d'analyse dans les projets actifs de découverte de médicaments. Le programme de bourses postdoctorales de recherche biomédicale de Novartis vise à développer la prochaine génération de leaders scientifiques, à stimuler l'avenir de la médecine, au moyen de recherches rigoureuses et d'expériences d'apprentissage immersif, comme la mise en oeuvre d'outils d'IA dans la recherche biomédicale.
