Job Description Summary
The AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow will develop cutting-edge machine learning and generative AI methods for treatment effect modeling, patient stratification, and virtual clinical trials using large-scale clinical trial datasets. The role combines methodological research in causal AI and predictive modeling with real-world biomedical applications, aiming to improve clinical decision-making, biomarker discovery, and trial design. The successful candidate will collaborate across multidisciplinary research teams and contribute to scientific publications and innovation in AI-driven drug development.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Program start date: October 1, 2026
Application deadline: July 15, 2026 EOB

Job Description
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join data42 in Basel, and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of machine learning and real-world biomedical impact. The goal: help re-define how clinical trials are analyzed, simulated and designed. You will have the opportunity to build next-generation models that go beyond prediction and learn treatment effects, tackle counterfactual reasoning at patient level, explore generative “digital patients” and synthetic trials. You will have access to one of the richest biomedical data environments globally. Clinical + biomarker + omics datasets from hundreds of thousands of patients across thousands of trials and real-world data assets for validation and generalization. Your project will contribute to improving patient stratification, biomarker identification, trial design and decision-making with the aim of laying the foundations for future virtual clinical trials. You will work with real clinical trial data at scale, combine methodological ML research + translational impact, collaborate with experts across ML, biology, and medicine to build the foundations for digital twins and in-silico trials.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders, powering the future of medicine, through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, such as implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network

We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in enga

Gamma di insalata: CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00 Descrizione del lavoro L'AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow svilupperà metodi di apprendimento automatico all'avanguardia e di AI generativi per la modellazione degli effetti del trattamento, la stratificazione dei pazienti e gli studi clinici virtuali utilizzando set di dati di prova clinici su larga scala. Il ruolo combina la ricerca metodologica nell'intelligenza artificiale causale e la modellazione predittiva con applicazioni biomediche del mondo reale, mirando a migliorare il processo decisionale clinico, la scoperta di biomarcatori e la progettazione di prova. Il candidato di successo collaborerà tra i team di ricerca multidisciplinari e contribuirà alle pubblicazioni scientifiche e all'innovazione nello sviluppo della droga guidata dall'IA. Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Durata: 3 anni Data di inizio programma: 1 ottobre 2026 Termine per la richiesta: 15 luglio 2026 EOB Descrizione del lavoro Siamo entusiasti di invitare le applicazioni per il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, un'opportunità di formazione unica progettata per gli scienziati eccezionali di pronto soccorso desiderosi di affrontare alcuni dei problemi più impegnativi nella ricerca biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. In qualità di ricerca postdoctoral Fellow, ti unirai ai dati42 di Basilea, e persegue un innovativo progetto di ricerca all'avanguardia nella scienza biomedica e nella scoperta della droga. Potrai lavorare insieme a scienziati leader in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e multidisciplinare, acquisendo l'esposizione all'ecosistema più ampio che traduce la scoperta scientifica in farmaci. I nostri compagni hanno il potere di porre domande scientifiche audaci, applicare tecnologie all'avanguardia e sviluppare approcci che hanno il potenziale di trasformare la cura del paziente. Opportunità di ricerca Questa è un'opportunità unica per lavorare alla frontiera dell'apprendimento automatico e dell'impatto biomedico del mondo reale. L'obiettivo: aiutare a ridefinire come gli studi clinici vengono analizzati, simulati e progettati. Avrete l'opportunità di costruire modelli di nuova generazione che vanno oltre la predizione e imparare gli effetti del trattamento, affrontare ragionamenti controfatti a livello del paziente, esplorare i "pazienti digitali" generativi e le prove sintetiche. Avrete accesso a uno dei più ricchi ambienti di dati biomedici a livello globale. Dataset clinico + biomarcatore + omics da centinaia di migliaia di pazienti attraverso migliaia di prove e dati reali per la convalida e la generalizzazione. Il vostro progetto contribuirà a migliorare la stratificazione del paziente, l'identificazione del biomarcatore, il design di prova e il processo decisionale con l'obiettivo di porre le basi per future sperimentazioni cliniche virtuali. Potrai lavorare con dati di prova clinici reali in scala, combinare la ricerca metodologica ML + impatto traduttivo, collaborare con esperti in ML, biologia e medicina per costruire le basi per gemelli digitali e prove in-silico. Perché partecipare al programma? Il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program è progettato per sviluppare la prossima generazione di leader scientifici, alimentando il futuro della medicina, attraverso una ricerca rigorosa e esperienze di apprendimento immersive, come l'implementazione di strumenti AI nella ricerca biomedica. I membri della ricerca postdoctoral beneficiano di:
• Guida da leader scientifici e esperti di materia
• Accesso a tecnologie, piattaforme e capacità di ricerca avanzate
• Collaborazione tra discipline e confini organizzativi
• Una comunità globale e diversificata di compagni postdottoriali
• Programmazione dedicata progettata per aiutare gli altri a prosperare durante la loro carriera.

• Opportunità di presentare la ricerca, pubblicare su riviste leader e costruire una rete scientifica internazionale Stiamo entrando in una nuova era di scoperte della ricerca biomedica attraverso la convergenza di biologia, tecnologia e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale, e i compagni sono anche sostenuti in enga

descriptionByLocale.de:
Gehaltsbereich: CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Der AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow wird hochmodernes maschinelles Lernen und generative KI-Methoden für die Modellierung von Behandlungseffekten, die Patientenschichtung und virtuelle klinische Studien mithilfe groß angelegter klinischer Studiendatensätze entwickeln. Die Rolle kombiniert methodische Forschung in der kausalen KI und prädiktive Modellierung mit realen biomedizinischen Anwendungen, mit dem Ziel, klinische Entscheidungsfindung, Biomarker-Entdeckung und Studiendesign zu verbessern. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird in multidisziplinären Forschungsteams zusammenarbeiten und zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und Innovationen in der KI-getriebenen Arzneimittelentwicklung beitragen. Standort: Basel, Schweiz Dauer: 3 Jahre Startdatum des Programms: 1. Oktober 2026 Bewerbungsfrist: 15. Juli 2026 EOB Stellenbeschreibung Wir freuen uns, Bewerbungen für das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program einzureichen, eine einzigartige Ausbildungsmöglichkeit für außergewöhnliche Nachwuchswissenschaftler, die einige der schwierigsten Probleme in der biomedizinischen Forschung und Wirkstoffforschung angehen möchten. Als Postdoctoral Research Fellow werden Sie bei data42 in Basel tätig sein und ein innovatives Forschungsprojekt an der Spitze der biomedizinischen Wissenschaft und Wirkstoffforschung verfolgen. Sie arbeiten mit führenden Wissenschaftlern in einem hochgradig kooperativen, multidisziplinären Umfeld zusammen und sind gleichzeitig dem breiteren Ökosystem ausgesetzt, das wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen in Medikamente übersetzt. Unsere Stipendiaten sind in der Lage, mutige wissenschaftliche Fragen zu stellen, innovative Technologien anzuwenden und Ansätze zu entwickeln, die das Potenzial haben, die Patientenversorgung zu verändern. Forschungsmöglichkeit Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Grenze des maschinellen Lernens und der realen biomedizinischen Auswirkungen zu arbeiten. Ziel: neu definieren, wie klinische Studien analysiert, simuliert und gestaltet werden. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Modelle der nächsten Generation zu erstellen, die über die Vorhersage hinausgehen und Behandlungseffekte lernen, kontrafaktisches Denken auf Patientenebene angehen, generative "digitale Patienten" und synthetische Studien erforschen. Sie haben Zugriff auf eine der reichsten biomedizinischen Datenumgebungen weltweit. Klinische + Biomarker + Omik-Datensätze von Hunderttausenden von Patienten in Tausenden von Studien und realen Datenbeständen zur Validierung und Generalisierung. Ihr Projekt wird dazu beitragen, Patientenschichtung, Biomarker-Identifikation, Studiendesign und Entscheidungsfindung zu verbessern, um die Grundlagen für zukünftige virtuelle klinische Studien zu legen. Sie arbeiten mit echten klinischen Studiendaten in großem Maßstab, kombinieren methodische ML-Forschung + translationale Auswirkungen, arbeiten mit Experten aus den Bereichen ML, Biologie und Medizin zusammen, um die Grundlagen für digitale Zwillinge und In-Silico-Studien zu schaffen. Warum dem Programm beitreten? Das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program wurde entwickelt, um die nächste Generation wissenschaftlicher Führungskräfte zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Medizin durch rigorose Forschung und immersive Lernerfahrungen wie die Implementierung von KI-Tools in der biomedizinischen Forschung voranzutreiben. Postdoktoranden profitieren von:
• Anleitung von erfahrenen wissenschaftlichen Führungskräften und Fachexperten
• Zugang zu fortschrittlichen Technologien, Plattformen und Forschungskapazitäten
• Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und organisatorische Grenzen hinweg
• Eine globale und vielfältige Gemeinschaft von Postdoktoranden
• Dedizierte Programme, die Stipendiaten während ihrer gesamten Karriere helfen sollen.
• Personalisierte Erfahrungslernmöglichkeiten durch ein Postdoc-Praktikum, das Stipendiaten befähigt, neue wissenschaftliche Bereiche zu erkunden, funktionsübergreifendes Fachwissen aufzubauen und ihre Wirkung über ihr primäres Forschungsprojekt hinaus zu erweitern.
• Möglichkeiten, Forschung zu präsentieren, in führenden Zeitschriften zu veröffentlichen und ein internationales wissenschaftliches Netzwerk aufzubauen Wir treten in eine neue Ära der biomedizinischen Forschung Durchbrüche durch die Konvergenz von Biologie, Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz Werkzeuge, und Stipendiaten werden auch in enga unterstützt

This role brings cross‑functional voices together – partnering closely with Customer Engagement, Marketing, Operations, Patient Services, and other key stakeholders – to ensure training is thoughtfully designed, aligned, and impactful. With a strong focus on collaboration and clarity, this individual provides strategic oversight to ensure training curricula effectively support teams and the patients they serve.

Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile a voi.

Il Direttore Associato, Product & Disease Training guida la valutazione, la strategia, il budgeting e la fornitura di formazione in-market e lancio per il portafoglio Spinal Muscular Atrophy nell'organizzazione Customer Engagement. Questo ruolo riunisce voci interfunzionali – collaborando strettamente con Customer Engagement, Marketing, Operazioni, Servizi Pazienti e altri stakeholder chiave – per garantire che la formazione sia pensata, allineata e incisiva. Responsabilità chiave:

• Condurre lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di una strategia globale di formazione del prodotto e della malattia, pienamente allineato con il posizionamento di marketing, le priorità del marchio e gli obiettivi di impegno del cliente.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Customer Engagement, Marketing e altri team di clienti per acquisire informazioni e integrarli in piani di formazione e progettazione del curriculum.

• Collabora con il team Customer Engagement (CE) Skills Training per perfezionare e fornire nuove esperienze di formazione in corso e di noleggio che supportano la disponibilità e il successo a lungo termine.

• Corso di laurea richiesto da 4 anni college o università .

• 2 + anni di esperienza di vendita in industrie farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche, sanitarie, o similarmente strutturate con team dispersi di grandi dimensioni geograficamente. Accogliamo anche candidati provenienti da altri ambienti complessi come dispositivi medici, diagnostica, servizi di scienze della vita, assicurazione, salute dei consumatori, tecnologia nologia, o settori B2B, in particolare dove forte leadership sul campo e impegno del cliente sono centrali al successo.

• Forte comprensione della strategia e dell'esecuzione del marchio, abbinata a solide conoscenze cliniche e terapeutiche.

• Acume di vendita dimostrata e business mindset, con la capacità di collegare i risultati di formazione a reali prestazioni e risultati del mondo.

• Ottima comunicazione, facilitazione, problem solving, e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di sintetizzare

• Jüngste Erfahrungen mit der Anwendung von KI-fähigen oder innovativen Instruktionsdesign-Ansätzen zur Verbesserung der Lerneffektivität und des Engagements.

• Starkes Verständnis der Markenstrategie und -durchführung, gepaart mit soliden klinischen und therapeutischen Kenntnissen.

• Demonstrierter Verkaufssinn und Business Mindset, mit der Fähigkeit, Trainingsergebnisse mit realer Weltleistung und -ergebnissen zu verbinden.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation, Erleichterung, Problemlösung und Beeinflussung von Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit zur Synthese

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Remote

Cette position peut être basée à distance n'importe où aux États-Unis (il peut y avoir certaines restrictions basées sur une entité juridique). Les attentes en matière d'horaires de travail et de déplacements (nationaux et/ou internationaux) seront définies par le gestionnaire embaucheur. Ce poste nécessitera un voyage de 30 %.

Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation pour ce rôle : veuillez vous inscrire seulement si cet emplacement est accessible à vous.

L'entreprise ne parrainera pas les visas pour ce poste.

Le directeur associé, Formation sur les produits et les maladies dirige l'évaluation, la stratégie, la budgétisation et la prestation de services sur le marché et lance la formation pour le portefeuille de l'Atrophie musculaire spinale au sein de l'organisation d'engagement des clients. Ce rôle rassemble des voix interfonctionnelles – en étroite collaboration avec l'engagement des clients, le marketing, les opérations, les services aux patients et d'autres intervenants clés – afin de s'assurer que la formation est conçue de façon réfléchie, harmonisée et efficace. En mettant fortement l'accent sur la collaboration et la clarté, cette personne assure une surveillance stratégique pour assurer que les programmes de formation soutiennent efficacement les équipes et les patients qu'elles servent.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Diriger l'élaboration et l'exécution d'une stratégie complète de formation sur les produits et les maladies, entièrement alignée sur le positionnement marketing, les priorités de la marque et les objectifs d'engagement des clients.

• S'associer étroitement avec les équipes d'engagement des clients, de marketing et d'autres clients pour saisir les idées et les intégrer aux plans de formation et à la conception des programmes.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe de formation sur l'engagement des clients (EC) afin d'affiner et de fournir de nouvelles expériences de recrutement et de formation continue qui appuient la préparation et le succès à long terme.

• Servir de membre actif des équipes de leadership fonctionnel du produit, fournissant des commentaires stratégiques et une perspective de formation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Diriger la conception et l'évolution des programmes de formation des produits en travaillant de concert avec des partenaires internes et des fournisseurs externes, en veillant à ce que le contenu reflète la dynamique du marché et les besoins des apprenants.

• Effectuer des évaluations continues des besoins à l'aide de la rétroaction des clients, des connaissances sur le terrain et de l'expertise sur les sujets afin d'informer et de renforcer continuellement la stratégie de formation.

• S'assurer que tous les documents de formation respectent les exigences en matière de conformité, de législation et de réglementation et reçoivent les approbations internes appropriées.

• Élaborer et fournir du contenu pour les réunions nationales et de district en partenariat avec des équipes de marque afin de renforcer la stratégie, les capacités et la confiance.

• Favoriser la durabilité et l'impact en définissant les paramètres, en suivant les ICR et en tirant parti des connaissances acquises avant et après la formation en collaboration avec les partenaires de la technologie et des opérations.

• Partenaire avec l'engagement des clients (EC) Les opérations visent à s'assurer que les associés qui font face aux clients remplissent les certifications requises et demeurent à jour sur les attentes en matière de formation.

Exigences essentielles:

• Baccalauréat requis de 4 ans collège ou université .

• 6+ ans d'expérience dans la formation aux ventes, avec une solide expérience de conception et de prestation d'expériences d'apprentissage impactées.

• 2 + ans d'expérience commerciale dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique, de la santé ou des industries structurées avec de grandes équipes dispersées géographiquement. Nous accueillons également des candidats provenant d'autres environnements complexes tels que les dispositifs médicaux, les diagnostics, les services en sciences de la vie, l'assurance, la santé des consommateurs, la technologie ou les secteurs B2B, en particulier lorsque le leadership sur le terrain et l'engagement de la clientèle sont essentiels au succès.

• Expérience récente de l'application d'approches de conception pédagogique de l'IA ‐ activées ou novatrices pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'engagement en matière d'apprentissage.

• Forte compréhension de la stratégie de marque et de l'exécution, jumelée à de solides connaissances cliniques et thérapeutiques.

• L'acuité des ventes démontrée et l'état d'esprit d'entreprise, avec la capacité de relier les résultats de la formation à la performance et aux résultats réels dans le monde.

• Excellente communication, facilitation, résolution de problèmes et influence des compétences, avec la capacité de synthétiser

CHF76,300.00 - CHF141,700.00

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Scientist to join our Comparative Medicine (CM) team. In this role, you will provide high-quality in vivo research support and contribute to the design and execution of preclinical studies within a dynamic, multidisciplinary research environment.

You will play a key role in ensuring scientific excellence, operational efficiency, and compliance with animal welfare and regulatory standards.

Job Description

Internal job title: Senior Scientist I/II
Position Location : Basel, CH onsite #LI-onsite

This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Join our Comparative Medicine team as a Senior Scientist I and play a pivotal role in advancing impactful preclinical research. In this highly specialised, hands-on position, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and execute in vivo studies, ensuring scientific excellence, operational efficiency, and the highest standards of animal welfare.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a cutting-edge research environment, contribute to meaningful drug discovery programmes, and help shape both study outcomes and team capabilities through your expertise, collaboration, and commitment to quality.

Key responsibilities:

• Provide hands-on in vivo research support , including compound administration, blood and tissue collection, and clinical observations

• Contribute to study design, setup, and implementation of animal models and experimental techniques

• Coordinate and execute PK/PD studies and support ex vivo or in vitro assays as required

• Collaborate closely with research teams to ensure alignment with scientific objectives and study parameters

• Support planning, scheduling, and operational coordination of research activities

• Contribute to team development , including training and mentoring colleagues

• Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements, SOPs, and animal welfare standards

Essential Requirements :

Education & Experience:

• Degree in Life Sciences or equivalent qualification (Bachelor + 7 year-experience in in vivo studies, or Master + 3 year-experience in in vivo studies). We may also consider recent PhD graduates (within last 3 years)

• LTK1 Certification (or equivalent)

Technical Expertise:

• Strong hands-on experience with in vivo techniques (e.g. dosing, sampling, clinical monitoring)

• Knowledge of PK/PD study execution and experimental design

• Familiarity with animal welfare regulations and SOP-driven environments

Skills & Competencies:

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality data

• High level of accountability, reliability, and scientific curiosity

• Proficient in English

Desirable Requirements:

• in vivo experience across multiple disease areas

* Please note that restrictions on flexible working may apply and will be discussed at interview stage if applicable. This role requires occasional weekend and holiday work.

Accessibility and Accommodation:

Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Analysis (Inactive), Computer Systems, Lifesciences (Inactive), Operating Systems (OS), Operational Excellence, Scientific Support (Inactive), Technical Support

Descrizione del lavoro
Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato senior altamente motivato per unirsi al nostro team di medicina comparativa (CM). In questo ruolo, fornirete supporto di ricerca in vivo di alta qualità e contribuire alla progettazione ed esecuzione di studi preclinici all'interno di un ambiente di ricerca dinamico e multidisciplinare.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l'eccellenza scientifica, l'efficienza operativa, e la conformità con il benessere degli animali e gli standard normativi.

Descrizione del lavoro

Titolo del lavoro interno: Senior Scientist I/II
Posizione: Basilea, CH in loco #LI-onsite

Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, in Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

Unisciti al nostro team di Medicina Comparativa come scienziato senior I e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere una ricerca preclinica efficace. In questa posizione altamente specializzata, pratica, collaborerai con team multidisciplinari per progettare ed eseguire studi in vivo, garantendo l'eccellenza scientifica, l'efficienza operativa e i più elevati standard di benessere animale.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per lavorare in un ambiente di ricerca all'avanguardia, contribuire a programmi di scoperta di farmaci significativi, e contribuire a plasmare i risultati di studio e le capacità del team attraverso la vostra competenza, collaborazione e impegno per la qualità.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Fornire assistenza in vivo alla ricerca , tra cui l'amministrazione dei composti, la raccolta del sangue e dei tessuti, e le osservazioni cliniche

• Contribuisci alla progettazione, alla configurazione e all'implementazione di modelli animali e tecniche sperimentali

• Coordinare ed eseguire studi PK/PD e sostenere saggi ex vivo o in vitro come richiesto

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di ricerca per garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi scientifici e i parametri di studio

• Pianificazione, pianificazione e coordinamento operativo delle attività di ricerca

• Contribuire allo sviluppo del team, compresi i colleghi di formazione e mentoring

• Assicurare il pieno rispetto dei requisiti normativi, delle SOP e degli standard di benessere degli animali

Requisiti essenziali:

Istruzione e esperienza:

• Laurea in Scienze della Vita o qualifica equivalente (Bachelor + 7 anni di esperienza in studi in vivo, o Master + 3 anni di esperienza in studi in vivo). Possiamo anche considerare i laureati di dottorato recenti (entro gli ultimi 3 anni)

• Certificazione LTK1 (o equivalente)

Competenza tecnica:

• Forte esperienza pratica con tecniche in vivo (ad esempio dosaggio, campionamento, monitoraggio clinico)

• Conoscenza dell'esecuzione di studi PK/PD e del design sperimentale

• Familiarità con i regolamenti sul benessere degli animali e gli ambienti guidati da SOP

Competenze e competenze:

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per i dati di alta qualità

• Alto livello di responsabilità, affidabilità e curiosità scientifica

• Proficiente in inglese

Requisiti desiderabili:

• esperienza in vivo in più aree di malattia

* Si prega di notare che le restrizioni sul lavoro flessibile possono essere applicate e saranno discusse in fase di intervista, se applicabile. Questo ruolo richiede occasionali weekend e lavoro di vacanza.

Accessibilità e alloggio:

Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, è necessario un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di una posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com e farci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Competenze desiderate

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Senior Scientist, der unserem Team für Vergleichende Medizin (CM) beitritt. In dieser Funktion bieten Sie qualitativ hochwertige In-vivo-Forschungsunterstützung und tragen zur Gestaltung und Durchführung präklinischer Studien in einem dynamischen, multidisziplinären Forschungsumfeld bei.

Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz, betrieblicher Effizienz und der Einhaltung von Tierschutz- und Regulierungsstandards.

Stellenbeschreibung

Interne Berufsbezeichnung: Senior Scientist I/II
Position Standort: Basel, CH vor Ort #LI-onsite

Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann für diese Rolle keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn dieser Standort für Sie zugänglich ist.

Treten Sie unserem Team für Vergleichende Medizin als Senior Scientist I bei und spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung einer wirkungsvollen präklinischen Forschung. In dieser hochspezialisierten, praxisorientierten Position arbeiten Sie mit multidisziplinären Teams zusammen, um In-vivo-Studien zu entwerfen und durchzuführen, um wissenschaftliche Exzellenz, operative Effizienz und höchste Standards für den Tierschutz zu gewährleisten.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, in einer hochmodernen Forschungsumgebung zu arbeiten, zu sinnvollen Wirkstoffforschungsprogrammen beizutragen und sowohl Studienergebnisse als auch Teamfähigkeiten durch Ihr Fachwissen, Ihre Zusammenarbeit und Ihr Engagement für Qualität zu gestalten.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Geben Sie praktische In-vivo-Forschungsunterstützung, einschließlich Substanzverwaltung, Blut- und Gewebeentnahme und klinische Beobachtungen

• Beitrag zur Untersuchung von Design, Einrichtung und Implementierung von Tiermodellen und experimentellen Techniken

• Koordination und Durchführung von PK/PD-Studien und Unterstützung von Ex-vivo- oder In-vitro-Assays nach Bedarf

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsteams, um die Ausrichtung auf wissenschaftliche Ziele und Studienparameter sicherzustellen

• Unterstützung der Planung, Planung und operativen Koordinierung von Forschungsaktivitäten

• Beitrag zur Teamentwicklung, einschließlich Schulung und Mentoring-Kollegen

• Gewährleistung der vollständigen Einhaltung der regulatorischen Anforderungen, SOPs und Tierschutzstandards

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

Bildung & Erfahrung:

• LTK1 Zertifizierung (oder gleichwertig)

Technische Expertise:

• Starke praktische Erfahrungen mit In-vivo-Techniken (z. B. Dosierung, Probenahme, klinische Überwachung)

• Vertrautheit mit Tierschutzbestimmungen und SOP-gesteuerten Umgebungen

Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen:

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für hochwertige Daten

• Englischkenntnisse

• In-vivo-Erfahrung in mehreren Krankheitsgebieten

Analyse (Inaktiv), Computersysteme, Lifesciences (Inaktiv), Betriebssysteme (OS), Operational Excellence, Wissenschaftlicher Support (Inaktiv), Technischer Support

76 300,00 CHF - 141 700,00 CHF

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Nous cherchons un scientifique principal très motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe de médecine comparée (CM). Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez un soutien de recherche in vivo de haute qualité et contribuerez à la conception et à l'exécution d'études précliniques dans un environnement de recherche dynamique et multidisciplinaire.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé en assurant l'excellence scientifique, l'efficacité opérationnelle et le respect des normes de bien-être animal et de réglementation.

Description de l'emploi

Titre de l'emploi interne : Chercheur principal I/II
Positionnement : Bâle, CH sur place #LI-sursite

Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir un soutien à la réinstallation pour ce rôle : veuillez ne postuler que si cet emplacement est accessible pour vous.

Joignez-vous à notre équipe de médecine comparée en tant que scientifique principal I et jouez un rôle central dans la promotion de la recherche préclinique impactée. Dans cette position hautement spécialisée, vous collaborerez avec des équipes multidisciplinaires pour concevoir et exécuter des études in vivo, assurant l'excellence scientifique, l'efficacité opérationnelle et les plus hauts standards de bien-être animal.

C'est une occasion unique de travailler dans un environnement de recherche de pointe, de contribuer à des programmes de découverte de médicaments significatifs et d'aider à façonner les résultats d'études et les capacités d'équipe grâce à votre expertise, votre collaboration et votre engagement envers la qualité.

Principales responsabilités :

• Fournir un soutien pratique à la recherche in vivo, y compris l'administration de composés, la collecte de sang et de tissus et les observations cliniques

• Contribuer à l'étude de la conception, de la configuration et de la mise en oeuvre de modèles animaux et de techniques expérimentales

• Coordonner et exécuter les études PK/PD et appuyer les essais ex vivo ou in vitro au besoin

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de recherche pour assurer l'alignement avec les objectifs scientifiques et les paramètres d'étude

• Appuyer la planification, le calendrier et la coordination opérationnelle des activités de recherche

• Contribuer au développement de l'équipe , y compris la formation et le mentorat de collègues

• Assurer le plein respect des exigences réglementaires, des PON et des normes de bien-être des animaux

Exigences essentielles :

Éducation et expérience :

• Diplôme en sciences de la vie ou diplôme équivalent (Bachelor + 7 ans d'expérience en études in vivo, ou Master + 3 ans d'expérience en études in vivo). Nous pouvons également envisager de récents doctorats (au cours des 3 dernières années)

• LTK1 Certification (ou équivalent)

Expertise technique :

• Forte expérience pratique des techniques in vivo (p. ex. dosage, échantillonnage, surveillance clinique)

• Connaissance de l'exécution des études PK/PD et de la conception expérimentale

• Connaissance des règlements sur le bien-être des animaux et des environnements axés sur les SOP

Compétences :

• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration

• Une grande attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur de données de haute qualité

• Niveau élevé de responsabilité, fiabilité et curiosité scientifique

• Compétence en anglais

Exigences souhaitables:

• expérience in vivo dans plusieurs zones de maladies

* Veuillez noter que des restrictions sur le travail flexible peuvent s'appliquer et seront discutées à l'étape de l'entrevue, s'il y a lieu. Ce rôle exige des week-ends et des vacances occasionnels.

Accessibilité et hébergement:

Novartis s'engage à travailler avec toutes les personnes et à leur offrir des aménagements raisonnables. Si, en raison d'une maladie ou d'un handicap, vous avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de recrutement, ou afin de recevoir des informations plus détaillées sur les fonctions essentielles d'un poste, veuillez envoyer un e-mail à inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com et nous faire savoir la nature de votre demande et vos coordonnées. Veuillez inclure le numéro de demande d'emploi dans votre message.

Compétences recherchées
Analyse (inactive), Systèmes informatiques, Sciences de la vie (inactive), Systèmes d'exploitation (OS), Excellence opérationnelle, Soutien scientifique (inactive), Soutien technique

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF93,800.00 - CHF174,200.00

Job Description Summary
• Location: Basel - Onsite
• #LI-Onsite
• Novartis cannot offer relocation for this role, please apply if this location is accessible to you.

About Us: Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis—where deep disease biology meets bold therapeutic innovation. In Oncology Drug Discovery Biology, we translate a precise understanding of cancer mechanisms into new therapeutic concepts and modalities. We are seeking a Ph.D.-level scientist with a strong track record in cancer biology to join our Oncology Research team in Basel, lead a laboratory, and help discover the next generation of oncology medicines for patients with high unmet medical need.
About this job: You will bring deep cancer biology expertise to generate, shape, and test bold new ideas for oncology drug discovery. Working with scientific peers and cross-functional partners, you will define and execute cutting-edge experimental strategies, generate high-quality data, validate targets and concepts, establish relevant cellular assays, and support the optimization and characterization of new molecular entities toward clinical proof of concept. Success in this role will require strong hands-on expertise in molecular and cell biology, rigorous experimental thinking to drive the mechanistic dissection of intracellular and cell surface targets, the ability to leverage bioinformatics and genome- and proteome-wide technologies to answer key biological questions, and knowledge in cutting-edge modalities and assays in emerging spaces such as Induced Proximity.
Why Join Us: At Novartis, you will grow as a scientist and leader while contributing to high-impact oncology projects. This role offers the opportunity to expand your expertise, build new skills, take on increasing responsibility, and help project teams advance breakthrough science with the potential to improve patients’ lives.

Job Description
• Major accountabilities include:
• · Lead a Drug Discovery Biology laboratory, guiding, supervising, and developing scientific associates to deliver high-quality experimental science.
• · Apply rigorous statistical thinking to large-scale datasets or other pertinent sources to identify new biological insights and therapeutic opportunities.
• · Design and execute smart and innovative experimental strategies that generate interpretable data, test hypotheses, answer key scientific questions, and move projects forward.
• · Implement cutting-edge technologies for target identification, validation, and structure/function studies and eventually drive drug discovery programs from inception through all stages
• · Partner closely across Oncology expertise groups and with teams across the global Novartis organization.
• · Communicate scientific concepts and project progress clearly, objectively, and data-driven across different settings and audiences.
• · Manage laboratory resources flexibly and effectively as priorities evolve.

Minimum requirements:
• · Ph.D. in cancer biology, molecular biology biochemistry or a related field, with limited (up to 5 years) postdoctoral experience preferred.
• · Evidenced productivity and proven ability to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, productive, and competitive scientific environment.
• · Experience in drug discovery and project leadership in biotech or pharmaceutical settings is a plus.
• · Experience with microscopy and imaging technologies is a plus.
• · Excellent communication and presentation skills across a broad range of topics and adapted to variety of audiences.
• · Proven ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members.
• · Fluency in English, oral and written.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Location: Cambridge MA, East Hanover NJ, US or Basel Switzerland. This role will follow a hybrid working model. If based in US, please apply to REQ-10076159
LI-#hybrid

The Novartis Strategy & Growth, Therapeutic Area Strategy team for Oncology & Hematology is seeking a new Executive Director, Therapeutic Area Strategy who will support the creation and update of a holistic TA strategy; provide early-phase commercial insights to project teams; guide TA-specific internal pipeline development and external licensing / acquisitions opportunities; and support integrated enterprise alignment across Biomedical Research (BR), Development, Strategy & Growth (S&G), and the Commercial US and International units.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Brings external benchmarking, analysis and insights, and judgement to support the TA Strategy Head in developing a holistic Novartis TA strategy that achieves sustainable growth in short, mid and long-term.

• Brings both understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and the core Therapeutic Areas (TA) and Disease area of Oncology & Hematology to derive insightful and differentiating competitive advantages over our peers.

• Provides key commercial insights to the R&D project teams, particularly for early phase programs. To do this effectively, in-market experience in the US is critical.

• Analyses reports and publications to extract key messages, including building product forecasts.

• Supports development and delivery of TA-specific strategic external insights to support identification of growth opportunities, emerging competitive challenges and support creation of a third-party view around key strategic levers, and commissions targeted primary research.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree required. Advanced degree (PhD, MD or other advanced University degree) and / or equivalent experience in life science/healthcare; MBA or consulting or equivalent experience highly preferred.

• In-depth TA knowledge (or track record to acquire required TA expertise effectively and rapidly) in Oncology and/or Hematology.

• Highly agile having the capacity to support a number of strategic DAs within a TA and multiple programs internal and external

• Substantial experience evaluating new product opportunities (through M&A, BD&L and internal re-search programs).

• 7-10 years of Industry pharma and/or medical devices Experience in Research & Development and/or commercial functions with experience conducting, commissioning, analyzing primary research

• Experience of strategy development and asset shaping early in lifecycle (any functional perspective)

• Recent (post 2015) local US in-market experience; local US experience includes working within the US market with the local US customers, US health care systems / systems

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Agile (Programming Methodology), Building Constructions, Business Development, Business Strategies, Communication, Curious Mindset, Data Analytics, Decision Making, Digital Oscilloscope, Finance, Go-to-Market Strategies, Influencing Skills, Leadership, Operations, Pipeline (Software), Prioritization, Strategic Alliances, Strategic Planning

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la réglementation des programmes mondiaux - Neuroscience

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF93,800.00 - CHF174,200.00

Job Description Summary
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, #LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Drive regulatory execution that enables innovation in neuroscience to reach patients faster. As Regulatory Affairs Manager – Neuroscience, you will play a key role in delivering regulatory strategies across assigned regions, ensuring high-quality submissions and effective interactions with Health Authorities. Working cross-functionally, you will translate complex scientific and clinical data into regulatory deliverables, supporting timely approvals and maintaining compliance throughout the product lifecycle. This role offers the opportunity to build deep regulatory expertise while contributing to impactful global programs in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Implement regulatory strategy and manage operational activities across assigned regions

• Support development of global regulatory strategy and identify risks or gaps for assigned regions

• Partner with regional teams to align regulatory plans and ensure effective execution

• Lead preparation of Health Authority interactions, including briefing documents and response plans

• Drive coordination and submission of regulatory dossiers across assigned regions

• Review, approve, and submit Clinical Trial Applications and Investigational New Drug applications

• Manage responses to Health Authority queries and support timely approvals while minimising delays

Essential Requirements

• Experience in regulatory affairs within pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments

• Knowledge of regulatory submission processes and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting regulatory strategy and execution across multiple regions

• Strong project management and organisational skills in a matrix environment

• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in regulatory decision-making

• Effective communication skills and ability to interpret and present technical information clearly

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please email inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com and share the nature of your request along with your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Benefits and Rewards: Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

titleByLocale.it: Associate Direttore, Analysis & Design Delivery Lead
titleByLocale.en: Associate Director, Analysis & Design Delivery Lead
titleByLocale.de: Associate Direktor, Analysis & Design Delivery Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Associate Directeur, Analysis & Design Delivery Lead

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00

Job Description Summary
Help shape how Novartis scientists discover the next generation of medicines. As Delivery Lead for Analysis & Design, you'll bring the platforms that turn experimental and computational data into scientific insight — from interactive AI/ML and agentic tools to the broader analysis and design capabilities that power drug discovery across established and advanced modalities.

You'll lead cross-functional teams to deliver real capabilities into the hands of researchers, working at the intersection of science, technology, and data. If you're energized by translating ambiguous research needs into concrete delivery, and want your work to directly enable how medicines are designed, we'd like to hear from you.

Job Description

Internal job title: Associate Director

Position Location: Basel, CH, onsite #LI-onsite

This role is based in Basel, CH.  Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Ready to shape the future of Biomedical Research through the next generation of scientific analysis and design platforms? As a Delivery Lead in the Analysis & Design Delivery Segment, you will drive the delivery and adoption of new and significantly enhanced digital capabilities for Biomedical Research, while leading a high-performing, cross-functional matrix team. Delivery is achieved through predictable, high-quality and time-bound initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and architecture.

The Delivery Lead role is instrumental in prioritizing, planning and executing initiatives, including release, scaling and transition to operations. You will ensure alignment with architectural, security and compliance standards, while playing a central role in enabling innovative value creation for Biomedical Research through strong delivery leadership and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

• You are accountable and own the outcomes of Analysis & Design, together with your delivery segment, by translating domain needs into initiative proposals and the delivery of such.

• Enable and expand Analysis & Design capabilities for Biomedical Research, including establishing the vision, value proposition, and strategic roadmap in alignment with business priorities and organizational objectives.

• Own the creation, delivery, and lifecycle transition of domain-specific software and assigned initiatives, including prioritization, planning, supplier selection, execution, rollout/scaling, and transition to operations.

• Drive predictable planning and execution across initiatives within scope, time, and budget, and in alignment with business stakeholders, adjacent initiatives, and Data & Digital functions.

• Provide delivery-segment prioritization and investment input to support strategic decisions and focus on high-value initiatives.

• Lead cross-functional matrix teams (internal/external), coordinate resources, define responsibilities, and ensure aligned execution across all delivery functions and vendor interfaces.

• Proactively manage expectations and escalate issues, risks, or dependencies appropriately, and act as the primary delivery interface, to ensure orchestration and manage trade-offs across initiatives.

• Communicate progress, challenges, successes, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and the wider organization.

• Ensure all initiative deliverables align with architectural standards, security guidelines, and our initiative governance model.

• Establish and maintain close relationships with other functions in Data & Digital as well as in corporate IT to collaborate on the delivery and improvement of corporate-owned platforms that serve Biomedical Research needs.

Essential for the role:

• Proven track record of delivering complex initiatives in the Analysis & Design domain on time and within budget, with 8 + years of experience delivering scientific software, data, or informatics platfo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata: CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00 Descrizione del lavoro Aiuta a modellare come gli scienziati Novartis scoprono la prossima generazione di farmaci. Come Delivery Lead for Analysis & Design, porterai le piattaforme che trasformano i dati sperimentali e computazionali in un'intuizione scientifica, dagli strumenti interattivi AI/ML e agentic alle più ampie capacità di analisi e progettazione che alimentano la scoperta della droga attraverso modalità consolidate e avanzate. Condurrai squadre interfunzionali per fornire capacità reali nelle mani dei ricercatori, lavorando all'incrocio tra scienza, tecnologia e dati. Se sei energizzato traducendo esigenze di ricerca ambigue nella consegna concreta, e vuoi che il tuo lavoro permetta direttamente come i farmaci sono progettati, vorremmo sentire da te. Descrizione del lavoro Titolo del lavoro interno: Associate Director Posizione: Basilea, CH, in loco #LI-onsite Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, CH. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi. Pronti a plasmare il futuro della ricerca biomedica attraverso la prossima generazione di piattaforme di analisi e progettazione scientifica? Come Lead di consegna nel Segmento Analisi & Design Delivery, guiderai la consegna e l'adozione di nuove e significativamente migliorate funzionalità digitali per la Ricerca Biomedica, mentre guiderai un team di matrice ad alte prestazioni e multifunzionali. La consegna è raggiunta attraverso iniziative prevedibili, di alta qualità e a tempo in linea con le priorità aziendali e l'architettura. Il ruolo di Delivery Lead è fondamentale per la priorità, la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di iniziative, tra cui rilascio, scaling e transizione alle operazioni. Garantirete l'allineamento con gli standard architettonici, di sicurezza e di conformità, mentre svolgete un ruolo centrale nel consentire la creazione di valore innovativo per la ricerca biomedica attraverso una forte leadership di consegna e l'impegno degli stakeholder. Responsabilità chiave:
• Sei responsabile e possiedi i risultati di Analysis & Design, insieme al tuo segmento di consegna, traducendo le esigenze di dominio in proposte di iniziativa e la consegna di tali.
• Abilitare e ampliare le capacità di analisi e progettazione per la ricerca biomedica, compresa la creazione della visione, la proposizione del valore e la roadmap strategica in linea con le priorità aziendali e gli obiettivi organizzativi.
• Possa la creazione, la consegna e la transizione del ciclo di vita di software specifici per il dominio e iniziative assegnate, tra cui priorità, pianificazione, selezione dei fornitori, esecuzione, rollout/scaling e transizione alle operazioni.
• Guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione prevedibili attraverso iniziative all'interno di ambito, tempo e budget, e in allineamento con gli stakeholder aziendali, iniziative adiacenti e funzioni Data & Digital.
• Fornire priorità alla consegna e input di investimento per sostenere le decisioni strategiche e concentrarsi su iniziative di alto valore.
• Lead cross-functional matrix team (internal/esterno), coordinare le risorse, definire le responsabilità e garantire l'esecuzione allineata in tutte le funzioni di consegna e le interfacce dei fornitori.
• Proattivamente gestire le aspettative e aumentare i problemi, i rischi o le dipendenze in modo appropriato, e agire come l'interfaccia di consegna primaria, per garantire l'orchestrazione e gestire i trade-off attraverso le iniziative.
• Comunicare i progressi, le sfide, i successi e i risultati chiaramente agli stakeholder e all'organizzazione più ampia.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le iniziative siano conformi agli standard architettonici, alle linee guida per la sicurezza e al nostro modello di governance delle iniziative.
• Stabilire e mantenere stretti rapporti con altre funzioni in Data & Digital così come nell'IT aziendale per collaborare alla consegna e al miglioramento delle piattaforme aziendali che servono le esigenze di Biomedical Research. Essenziale per il ruolo:
• Provato record di tracciato di fornire iniziative complesse nel dominio Analisi & Design nel tempo e nel budget, con 8 + anni di esperienza di fornitura di software scientifico, dati, o informatica platfo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Gehaltsbereich: CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Helfen Sie mit, wie Novartis-Wissenschaftler die nächste Generation von Medikamenten entdecken. Als Delivery Lead für Analysis & Design bringen Sie die Plattformen, die experimentelle und computergestützte Daten in wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse verwandeln - von interaktiven AI / ML und agentischen Tools bis hin zu breiteren Analyse- und Designfähigkeiten, die die Wirkstoffforschung über etablierte und fortschrittliche Modalitäten hinweg vorantreiben. Sie leiten funktionsübergreifende Teams, um echte Fähigkeiten in die Hände von Forschern zu bringen, die an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Technologie und Daten arbeiten. Wenn Sie durch die Übersetzung mehrdeutiger Forschungsbedürfnisse in eine konkrete Lieferung motiviert sind und möchten, dass Ihre Arbeit direkt ermöglicht, wie Medikamente entwickelt werden, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören. Stellenbeschreibung Interne Berufsbezeichnung: Associate Director Position Lage: Basel, CH, vor Ort #LI-onsite Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, CH. Novartis kann für diese Rolle keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn dieser Standort für Sie zugänglich ist. Bereit, die Zukunft der biomedizinischen Forschung durch die nächste Generation wissenschaftlicher Analyse- und Designplattformen zu gestalten? Als Delivery Lead im Segment Analysis & Design Delivery werden Sie die Bereitstellung und Einführung neuer und deutlich verbesserter digitaler Fähigkeiten für die biomedizinische Forschung vorantreiben und gleichzeitig ein leistungsstarkes, funktionsübergreifendes Matrixteam leiten. Die Lieferung wird durch vorhersehbare, qualitativ hochwertige und zeitgebundene Initiativen erreicht, die auf Unternehmensprioritäten und -architektur ausgerichtet sind. Die Rolle des Delivery Lead ist entscheidend für die Priorisierung, Planung und Durchführung von Initiativen, einschließlich Release, Skalierung und Übergang zum Betrieb. Sie stellen die Ausrichtung auf Architektur-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards sicher und spielen gleichzeitig eine zentrale Rolle bei der Ermöglichung innovativer Wertschöpfung für die biomedizinische Forschung durch starke Lieferführerschaft und Stakeholder-Engagement. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Sie sind rechenschaftspflichtig und besitzen die Ergebnisse von Analysis & Design zusammen mit Ihrem Liefersegment, indem Sie die Domänenanforderungen in Initiativvorschläge und deren Lieferung übersetzen.
• Ermöglichung und Erweiterung der Analyse- und Designfunktionen für die biomedizinische Forschung, einschließlich der Festlegung der Vision, des Wertversprechens und der strategischen Roadmap in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäftsprioritäten und organisatorischen Zielen. Eigentümer der Erstellung, Bereitstellung und des Lebenszyklusübergangs von domänenspezifischer Software und zugewiesenen Initiativen, einschließlich Priorisierung, Planung, Lieferantenauswahl, Ausführung, Rollout / Skalierung und Übergang zum Betrieb.
• Vorhersagbare Planung und Ausführung von Initiativen innerhalb von Umfang, Zeit und Budget sowie in Abstimmung mit Geschäftsinteressenten, benachbarten Initiativen und Daten- und Digitalfunktionen.
• Priorisierung von Liefersegmenten und Investitionsinput, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und sich auf hochwertige Initiativen zu konzentrieren. Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Matrixteams (intern/extern), koordinieren Sie Ressourcen, definieren Sie Verantwortlichkeiten und gewährleisten Sie eine abgestimmte Ausführung über alle Lieferfunktionen und Lieferantenschnittstellen hinweg.
• Erwartungen proaktiv verwalten und Probleme, Risiken oder Abhängigkeiten angemessen eskalieren und als primäre Lieferschnittstelle fungieren, um die Orchestrierung und das Management von Kompromissen zwischen Initiativen sicherzustellen.
• Kommunizieren Sie Fortschritte, Herausforderungen, Erfolge und Ergebnisse klar an die Stakeholder und die breitere Organisation.
• Sicherstellen, dass alle Ergebnisse der Initiative mit architektonischen Standards, Sicherheitsrichtlinien und unserem Initiativ-Governance-Modell übereinstimmen.
• Aufbau und Pflege enger Beziehungen zu anderen Funktionen in Data & Digital sowie in der Unternehmens-IT, um bei der Bereitstellung und Verbesserung von unternehmenseigenen Plattformen zusammenzuarbeiten, die die Bedürfnisse der biomedizinischen Forschung erfüllen. Wesentlich für die Rolle:
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Initiativen im Bereich Analysis & Design rechtzeitig und innerhalb des Budgets, mit über 8 Jahren Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Software, Daten oder Informatik platfo
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 122500,00 CHF - 227 500,00 CHF Sommaire de la description d'emploi Aidez à façonner la façon dont les scientifiques de Novartis découvrent la prochaine génération de médicaments. En tant que responsable de livraison pour l'analyse et la conception, vous apporterez les plates-formes qui transforment les données expérimentales et computationnelles en données scientifiques, allant des outils interactifs d'IA/ML et d'agents aux capacités d'analyse et de conception plus larges qui alimentent la découverte de médicaments selon des modalités établies et avancées. Vous dirigerez des équipes interfonctionnelles pour fournir des capacités réelles aux chercheurs, travaillant à l'intersection de la science, de la technologie et des données. Si vous êtes sous tension en traduisant des besoins de recherche ambigus en livraison concrète, et si vous voulez que votre travail permette directement la conception des médicaments, nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles. Description de l'emploi Titre du poste interne : Directeur associé Position: Bâle, CH, sur place #LI-sursite Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, CH. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir un soutien à la réinstallation pour ce rôle : veuillez ne postuler que si cet emplacement est accessible pour vous. Prêt à façonner l'avenir de la recherche biomédicale par la prochaine génération de plateformes d'analyse et de conception scientifiques? En tant que responsable de la livraison dans le segment Analyse et conception de la livraison, vous dirigerez la livraison et l'adoption de nouvelles capacités numériques considérablement améliorées pour la recherche biomédicale, tout en dirigeant une équipe de matrice multifonctionnelle performante. L'exécution est réalisée grâce à des initiatives prévisibles, de qualité et assorties de délais conformes aux priorités et à l'architecture de l'entreprise. Le rôle de chef de file en matière d'exécution joue un rôle déterminant dans la hiérarchisation, la planification et l'exécution des initiatives, y compris la diffusion, la mise à l'échelle et la transition vers les opérations. Vous assurerez l'alignement sur les normes architecturales, de sécurité et de conformité, tout en jouant un rôle central dans la création de valeur novatrice pour la recherche biomédicale grâce à un leadership solide en matière d'exécution et à l'engagement des intervenants. Principales responsabilités :
• Vous êtes responsable et propriétaire des résultats de l'analyse et de la conception, ainsi que de votre segment de livraison, en traduisant les besoins du domaine en propositions d'initiative et de livraison de ce type.
• Permettre et développer les capacités d'analyse et de conception pour la recherche biomédicale, y compris l'établissement de la vision, de la proposition de valeur et de la feuille de route stratégique en conformité avec les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs organisationnels.
• Posséder la création, la livraison et la transition du cycle de vie de logiciels spécifiques au domaine et d'initiatives assignées, y compris la hiérarchisation, la planification, la sélection des fournisseurs, l'exécution, le déploiement et l'échelle, et la transition vers les opérations.
• Conduire une planification et une exécution prévisibles entre les initiatives, dans les limites de la portée, du temps et du budget, et en accord avec les parties prenantes, les initiatives adjacentes et les fonctions Data & Digital.
• Établir des priorités en matière de prestation des services et des investissements pour appuyer les décisions stratégiques et mettre l'accent sur les initiatives de grande valeur.
• Diriger les équipes matricielles interfonctionnelles (internes/externes), coordonner les ressources, définir les responsabilités et assurer l'exécution harmonisée de toutes les fonctions de prestation et des interfaces avec les fournisseurs.
• Gérer les attentes de manière proactive et accroître les problèmes, les risques ou les dépendances de façon appropriée, et agir comme principale interface de prestation, pour assurer l'orchestration et gérer les compromis entre les initiatives.
• Communiquer clairement les progrès, les défis, les succès et les résultats aux parties prenantes et à l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Veiller à ce que tous les produits livrables de l'initiative soient conformes aux normes architecturales, aux lignes directrices en matière de sécurité et à notre modèle de gouvernance de l'initiative.
• Établir et entretenir des relations étroites avec d'autres fonctions dans le domaine des données et du numérique ainsi qu'au sein de l'informatique de l'entreprise afin de collaborer à la prestation et à l'amélioration de plateformes appartenant à l'entreprise qui répondent aux besoins de la recherche biomédicale. Élément essentiel du rôle :
• Expérience éprouvée de la réalisation d'initiatives complexes dans le domaine de l'analyse et de la conception dans les délais et dans les limites du budget, avec 8 + ans d'expérience de la fourniture de logiciels scientifiques, de données ou d'informatique platfo

Job Description Summary
Executive Director, Region Europe Communications & Patient Advocacy

#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Shape the voice and impact of Communications & Patient Advocacy across Europe at a pivotal moment for healthcare. As Executive Director, you will partner closely with the Regional President to drive strategic alignment, elevate performance, and ensure consistent, high-quality execution across markets. This is a unique opportunity to lead and inspire a diverse regional network, influence business-critical decisions, and translate global strategies into meaningful outcomes that strengthen reputation and deliver impact for patients and communities.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as strategic Communications & Patient Advocacy partner to the Regional President and Leadership Team

• Drive performance, accountability, and execution quality across regional Communications & Patient Advocacy teams

• Translate global strategies into clear regional priorities and ensure consistent country-level execution

• Lead and coach country heads to strengthen capability, impact, and business acumen

• Enable effective executive communications aligned with global narratives and enterprise priorities

• Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across a high-performing regional network

• Oversee media relations, reputation management, and crisis response across priority markets

• Optimize regional resources and budgets to focus investment on highest-impact activities

• Drive AI upskilling and AI enablement of workflows within C&PtA country teams

Essential Requirements

• Extensive experience in communications, patient advocacy, or corporate affairs within a global, matrixed organization

• Proven track record partnering with senior commercial or general management leaders at executive level

• Strong experience leading multi-country teams with accountability for performance and delivery

• Expertise in media relations, reputation management, and crisis or issues management

• Experience working with patient organizations and advocacy groups in regulated healthcare environments

• Excellent leadership, influencing, and coaching skills across diverse, matrixed teams

• Deep understanding of healthcare systems, policy, and access dynamics across multiple geographies

• Ability to translate strategy into execution and drive measurable business impact

• AI fluency in day-to-day execution and efficiency, as well as understanding of AI impact on external landscape

• Degree required; advanced degree preferred (Public Policy, International Relations, Political Science, Communications, or related field)

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 159,600 CHF to 296,400 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.
The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.
